l-m-m3-b01-01.title: Nchikọta ọnụọgụ irrational ọ na-abụ irrational mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b01-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nchikọta ọnụọgụ irrational abụọ na-abụ irrational mgbe niile ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe a gbakwụnyere ọnụọgụ irrational abụọ, nchikọta na-abụkwa irrational. Chọta mgbakwunye na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: Nchikọta √2+√3 bụkwa irrational. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: √8=2√2, ya mere nchikọta 3√2 bụkwa irrational. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Nchikọta 3√5 bụkwa irrational. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s1.explain: √2+(−√2)=0 bụ rational. Nchikọta nwere ike ịbụ rational; nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: √2 na −√2 abụọ bụ irrational, mana nchikọta ha bụ 0, 0 bụkwa rational; ya mere ọ na-emegide nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbakwunye ọnụọgụ irrational abụọ nwere naanị akara dị iche na-enye 0; ya mere ụfọdụ nchikọta abụghị irrational.

l-m-m3-b01-02.title: Quadratic equation ọ na-enwe ezigbo azịza mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b01-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na quadratic equation na-enwe opekata mpe otu ezigbo azịza mgbe niile ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: quadratic equation na-enwe opekata mpe otu ezigbo azịza mgbe niile. Chọta equation na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: x=3 ma ọ bụ x=−3 bụ azịza. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.b: x=2 bụ azịza. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: x=3 ma ọ bụ x=−1 bụ azịza. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s1.explain: x²+4=0 pụtara x²=−4, mana square nke ezigbo ọnụọgụ enweghị ike ịdị njọ; ya mere ezigbo azịza adịghị.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: Ọ ga-achọ ka x²=−4, mana square nke ezigbo ọnụọgụ bụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa; ya mere ezigbo azịza adịghị, ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.
l-m-m3-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ niile nwere azịza, mana x²+4 na-erughị 4 mgbe niile ma ọ gaghị abụ 0; ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-m-m3-b01-03.title: Quadratic expression ọ̀ nwere ike ịbụ factor n’ime integer mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b01-03.topic: Ịtọgbọ quadratic expression ka ọ bụrụ factors
l-m-m3-b01-03.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na x²+bx+c nwere ike ịtọgbọ mgbe niile site na integer p na q ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: A pụrụ ịtọgbọ quadratic expression x²+bx+c mgbe niile dịka (x+p)(x+q) site n’ịchọta integer p na q. Chọta expression na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-aghọ (x+2)(x+3). Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-aghọ (x−3)(x+2). Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-aghọ (x+3)(x−3). Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s1.explain: Maka x²+x+1, enweghị integer abụọ nchikọta ha bụ 1, ngwaahịa ha bụ 1; ya mere enweghị ike ịtọgbọ ya na integer p na q.
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s2.model.0: Enweghị integer abụọ nchikọta ha bụ 1 na ngwaahịa ha bụ 1; ya mere x²+x+1 enweghị ike ịbụ (x+p)(x+q).
l-m-m3-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: Maka expression ndị ọzọ a pụrụ ịchọta integer p na q abụọ, mana x²+x+1 enweghị; ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta.

l-m-m3-b01-04.title: Uru trigonometric ratio ọ na-adị 1 ma ọ bụ obere mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b01-04.goal: Nyochaa ma uru trigonometric ratio na-adị 1 ma ọ bụ obere mgbe niile ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe 0°<A<90°, uru sin A, cos A na tan A niile bụ 1 ma ọ bụ obere mgbe niile. Chọta ratio na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ trigonometric ratio na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ chere ihu dị mkpụmkpụ karịa hypotenuse, ya mere sin 70°<1. Ọ dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: Akụkụ dị n’akụkụ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa hypotenuse, ya mere cos 20°<1. Ọ dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: tan 30°≈0.58 dị 1 ma ọ bụ obere. Ọ dabara nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s1.explain: tan 60°=√3≈1.73, nke karịrị 1. Ọ bụrụ akụkụ chere ihu dị ogologo karịa nke dị n’akụkụ, tan karịrị 1.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: tan 60°=√3≈1.73 karịrị 1; ya mere ọ na-emegide nkwupụta na trigonometric ratio niile bụ 1 ma ọ bụ obere.
l-m-m3-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: tan bụ ịdị elu÷ntọala; mgbe ịdị elu dị ogologo karịa ntọala ọ karịrị 1, ya mere tan 60° bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-m-m3-b01-05.title: Quadrilateral ọ bụla e sere n’ime okirikiri ọ bụ rectangle?
l-m-m3-b01-05.topic: Quadrilateral ndị e sere n’ime okirikiri
l-m-m3-b01-05.goal: Nyochaa ma quadrilateral ọ bụla e sere n’ime okirikiri bụ rectangle mgbe niile ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Quadrilateral ọ bụla e sere n’ime okirikiri bụ rectangle. Chọta nke na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s1.r.a: Square bụkwa rectangle. Ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s1.o.c: Rectangle diagonal ya bụ dayameta okirikiri
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s1.o.d: Isosceles trapezoid nwere elu 4 na ala 8
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s1.explain: N’ime isosceles trapezoid, akụkụ abụọ na-emegide ibe ha na-agbakọta 180°, ya mere a pụrụ ise ya n’ime okirikiri. Ọ bụghị rectangle, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: N’ime isosceles trapezoid, akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha na-agbakọta 180°, ya mere ọ dị n’ime okirikiri; mana akụkụ anọ ya adịghị hà nhata, ya mere ọ bụghị rectangle.
l-m-m3-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ abụọ yiri ya dị iche, 4 na 8; ya mere ọ bụghị rectangle, mana a pụrụ ise ya n’ime okirikiri. Nke a bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-m-m3-b02-01.title: Eserese ọrụ quadratic ọ̀ na-ezute axis x mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b02-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “eserese ọrụ quadratic na-ezute ahịrị x mgbe niile” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Eserese ọrụ quadratic na-ezute ahịrị x n'otu isi ma ọ bụ karịa mgbe niile. Chọta ọrụ quadratic na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ọrụ quadratic na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ na-agbagha ya).
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ezute ahịrị x mgbe x=2 na x=−2. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Vertex (1, 0) dị n'ahịrị x, ya mere ọ na-ezute ya. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ezute ahịrị x mgbe x=3 na x=−3. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s1.explain: y=(x−2)²+1 nwere vertex na (2, 1), ọ na-echekwa ihu n'elu, ya mere y≥1, ọ dịghịkwa mgbe ọ na-emetụ ahịrị x.
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s2.model.0: (x−2)²≥0, ya mere y na-adị opekata mpe 1 mgbe niile, ọ naghị ezutekwa ahịrị x (y=0).
l-m-m3-b02-01.s.s2.model.1: Vertex (2, 1) dị n'elu ahịrị x, eserese ahụ na-eche ihu n'elu, ya mere eserese niile dị n'elu ahịrị x; nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-m3-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbakwunye otu uru na data nke nkezi ya bụ 10, nkezi na-abawanye mgbe niile. Chọta ọnọdụ na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b02-03.topic: Nha akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri
l-m-m3-b02-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri na-adị obere karịa 90° mgbe niile” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b02-03.material: Nkwupụta: Akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri nke na-ahụ arc AB site n'isi ihe dị n'okirikiri na-adị obere karịa 90° mgbe niile. Chọta arc na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s1.prompt: Arc dị aṅaa na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ na-agbagha ya)?
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ 40°, nke pere mpe karịa 90°. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: Akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ 60°, nke pere mpe karịa 90°. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s1.r.c: Akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ 80°, nke pere mpe karịa 90°. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na nha arc bụ 220°, akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ 110°, nke karịrị 90°. Nke a na-eme mgbe arc karịrị ọkara okirikiri.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na nha arc bụ 220°, akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ ọkara ya, 110°, nke karịrị 90°, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na arc karịrị ọkara okirikiri (180°), akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya karịrị 90°, ọkara nke 180°; ya mere 220° bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-m3-b02-04.title: Ọ bụrụ na hypotenuse dị ogologo karịa, ịdị elu ọ na-adị ogologo karịa mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b02-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “triangle akụkụ aka nri nwere hypotenuse ogologo karịa nwekwara ịdị elu ogologo karịa” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe ị na-atụnyere triangle akụkụ aka nri abụọ, nke nwere hypotenuse ogologo karịa nwekwara ịdị elu ogologo karịa. Chọta triangle abụọ na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.o.a: Hypotenuse 5, ịdị elu 3; hypotenuse 10, ịdị elu 6
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ịdị elu 6 nke triangle nwere hypotenuse ogologo karịa dị ogologo. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.o.b: Hypotenuse 6, ịdị elu 5; hypotenuse 8, ịdị elu 3
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.o.c: Hypotenuse 10, ịdị elu 4; hypotenuse 12, ịdị elu 5
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị elu 5 nke triangle nwere hypotenuse ogologo karịa dị ogologo. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.o.d: Hypotenuse 13, ịdị elu 5; hypotenuse 17, ịdị elu 8
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.r.d: Ịdị elu 8 nke triangle nwere hypotenuse ogologo karịa dị ogologo. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s1.explain: Triangle nwere hypotenuse 8 nwere ịdị elu 3, nke dị mkpụmkpụ karịa ịdị elu 5 nke triangle nwere hypotenuse 6. Ịdị elu bụ hypotenuse×sin A.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: Hypotenuse 8 dị ogologo karịa, ma ịdị elu ya bụ 3; triangle nwere hypotenuse 6 nwere ịdị elu 5, ya mere ịdị elu dị mkpụmkpụ n'ezie, nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị elu bụ hypotenuse e mụbara na sin A; ya mere ọ bụrụ na akụkụ nkuku pere mpe, ịdị elu nwere ike ịdị mkpụmkpụ ọ bụrụgodị na hypotenuse dị ogologo karịa.

l-m-m3-b02-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na √a×√b bụ ọnụọgụ eke, a na b ọ̀ bụ square zuru oke?
l-m-m3-b02-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “ọ bụrụ na √a×√b bụ ọnụọgụ eke, a na b bụ square zuru oke” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b02-05.material: Nkwupụta: Maka ọnụọgụ eke a na b, ọ bụrụ na √a×√b bụ ọnụọgụ eke, a na b bụ square zuru oke. Chọta (a, b) na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-05.s.s1.r.a: √4×√9=6, 4 na 9 bụkwa square zuru oke. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-05.s.s1.r.b: √9×√16=12, 9 na 16 bụkwa square zuru oke. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-05.s.s1.r.d: √1×√25=5, 1 na 25 bụkwa square zuru oke. Ọ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-m3-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: N'ime x²+bx+c, ọ bụrụ b bụ even, expression bụ perfect square mgbe niile. Chọta expression na-egosi na nke a ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.explain: x²+4x+3=(x+1)(x+3) abụghị ngwaahịa nke otu linear expression ugboro abụọ. Ọbụna b bụrụ even, ọ bụghị perfect square.

l-m-m3-b04-01.material: Nkwupụta: √n nke natural number n na-abụ irrational mgbe niile. Chọta n na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.a: √2 bụ irrational, ya mere ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.b: √7 bụkwa irrational; ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.d: √3 bụkwa irrational; ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s1.explain: √25=5 bụ rational. Square root nke square number bụ natural number, ya mere ọ bụghị irrational.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ n=25, √25=5; 5 bụ rational. Ọ bụghị irrational, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.
l-m-m3-b04-01.s.s2.model.1: 25 bụ square nke 5; ya mere √25=5 bụ natural number, nkwupụta ahụ adabaghị.

l-m-m3-b04-06.title: a²−b²=(a−b)² ọ̀ na-abụ eziokwu mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b04-06.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta a²−b²=(a−b)² ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha ya), kọwaa ya.
l-m-m3-b04-06.material: Nkwupụta: Maka ọnụọgụ a na b ọ bụla, a²−b² na (a−b)² nwere otu uru. Chọta a na b na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s1.r.a: 16 na 16 bụ otu. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s1.r.b: 25 na 25 bụ otu. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: 0 na 0 bụ otu. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=3 na b=1, a²−b²=8, (a−b)²=4, ha dị iche. Ihe kpatara ya bụ (a−b)²=a²−2ab+b².
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na a=3 na b=1, 3²−1²=8, ma (3−1)²=4. Uru abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: (a−b)²=a²−2ab+b², ya mere ha dị iche mgbe b abụghị 0, a≠b. 3 na 1 bụ ihe atụ dị otú ahụ, ya mere nke a na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-m3-b04-21.title: tan A ọ na-adị obere karịa 1 mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b04-21.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta tan A na-adị obere karịa 1 mgbe niile ziri ezi, chọta ọnọdụ ọ na-adịghị (counterexample), kọwaa ya.
l-m-m3-b04-21.material: Nkwupụta: N'ime right triangle, tan A na-adị mgbe niile obere karịa 1. (tan A=ịdị elu÷base) Chọta triangle na-egosi na nke a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s1.r.b: tan A=0.4 dị obere karịa 1. Nke a dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s1.r.c: tan A=8/9 dị obere karịa 1. Nke a dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s1.r.d: tan A=5/6 dị obere karịa 1. Nke a dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s1.explain: Na base 2 na ịdị elu 7, tan A=7/2=3.5, karịrị 1. Ọ bụrụ ịdị elu dị ogologo karịa base, ọ karịrị 1.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s2.model.0: Ịdị elu 7 dị ogologo karịa base 2, ya mere tan A=7/2=3.5 karịrị 1, ya mere counterexample.
l-m-m3-b04-21.s.s2.model.1: Ka tan A dị obere karịa 1, ịdị elu ga-adị mkpụmkpụ karịa base, ma triangle ịdị elu ya toro ogologo na-eme ka ọ gafee 1, ya mere counterexample.

l-m-m3-b04-31.title: Ọ bụrụ ogologo arc hà nhata, central angle hà nhata kwa?
l-m-m3-b04-31.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “ọ bụrụ ogologo arc hà nhata, central angle hà nhata kwa” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b04-31.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ arcs abụọ nwere ogologo hà nhata, central angles ha hà nhata. Chọta arc abụọ na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ arcs abụọ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.o.a: Arcs abụọ ogologo ha hà nhata n’otu okirikiri
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.r.a: N’otu okirikiri, ma ogologo ha hà nhata, central angles hà nhata kwa.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.o.b: Arcs ogologo ha hà nhata n’okirikiri abụọ nwere radius 5
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ radius hà nhata, ogologo arc hà nhata pụtara central angles hà nhata kwa.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.o.c: Arcs ogologo ha hà nhata n’okirikiri radius 4 na radius 8
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.o.d: Arcs ogologo hà nhata n’okirikiri congruent abụọ
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.r.d: N’okirikiri congruent, ma ogologo hà nhata, central angles hà nhata.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s1.explain: Arc 90° nke okirikiri radius 4 na arc 45° nke okirikiri radius 8 abụọ nwere ogologo 2π, mana central angles dị iche.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s2.model.0: Arc 90° nke radius 4 na arc 45° nke radius 8 abụọ nwere ogologo 2π mana angles dị iche; ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ megidere.
l-m-m3-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo arc dabere na radius kwa; ya mere n’okirikiri radius dị iche, central angle nwere ike ịdị iche n’agbanyeghị na ogologo hà nhata.

l-m-m3-b04-36.title: Ọ bụrụ variance buru ibu, maximum ọ̀ buru ibu kwa?
l-m-m3-b04-36.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “data nwere variance ka ukwuu nwekwara maximum ka ukwuu” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-m-m3-b04-36.material: Nkwupụta: N’ime data A na B, nke variance ya ka ukwuu nwekwara maximum ka ukwuu. Chọta A na B na-egosi na nke a ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s1.r.a: A nwere variance ka ukwuu, A nwekwara maximum ka ukwuu; ya mere ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s1.r.b: A nwere variance ka ukwuu, A nwekwara maximum ka ukwuu; ya mere ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s1.r.d: A nwere variance ka ukwuu, A nwekwara maximum ka ukwuu; ya mere ọ dabara nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s1.explain: A: variance nke 1 na 9 bụ 16; B: variance nke 10 na 12 bụ 1; mana maximum A bụ 9, nke dị obere.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s2.model.0: Variance A bụ 16, B bụ 1, mana maximum bụ 9 maka A na 12 maka B. Nke nwere variance ka ukwuu nwere maximum dị obere; ya mere ihe atụ megidere.
l-m-m3-b04-36.s.s2.model.1: Variance na-egosi etu uru si gbasaa, ọ bụghị etu ha si buru ibu. 1 na 9 gbasara, mana maximum bụ naanị 9, nke dị obere karịa 12.

l-m-m3-b05-01.title: Ọ bụrụ i mee square irrational number, ọ na-abụ irrational?
l-m-m3-b05-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “ịme square irrational number na-enye irrational mgbe niile” bụ eziokwu, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-abụghị ya (counterexample).
l-m-m3-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: Maka irrational number x, x², square ya, na-abụ irrational mgbe niile. Chọta irrational number x na-egosi na nkwupụta ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: Ime square na-enye 19+6√2, nke bụ irrational, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s1.r.c: Ime square na-enye 3+2√2, nke bụ irrational, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s1.r.d: Ime square na-enye 7+4√3, nke bụ irrational, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s1.explain: (√6)²=6 bụ rational number. √6 bụ irrational, ma square ya abụghị irrational.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s2.model.0: x=√6 bụ irrational, ma (√6)²=6, 6 bụ rational, ya mere counterexample.
l-m-m3-b05-01.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe i mere square number nwere root sign, root sign na-apụ, ya mere 6, square √6, abụghị irrational.

l-m-m3-b05-06.title: Ọ bụrụ Constant Term bụ Prime, ọ gaghị enwe factoring?
l-m-m3-b05-06.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “ọ bụrụ constant term bụ prime, enweghị ike ime factoring” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m3-b05-06.material: Nkwupụta: N'ime x²+px+q, ọ bụrụ constant term q bụ prime, enweghị ike ime ya product nke linear expressions abụọ nwere integer coefficients. Chọta expression na-egosi na nke a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị integer abụọ ngụkọta ha bụ 5, ngwaahịa 7, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s1.r.b: Enweghị integer abụọ ngụkọta 2, ngwaahịa 3, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị integer abụọ ngụkọta 1, ngwaahịa 5, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s1.explain: x²+4x+3=(x+1)(x+3). Ọbụna constant term 3 bụ prime, enwere ike ime factoring.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s2.model.0: Maka x²+4x+3, 1 na 3 nwere ngụkọta 4, ngwaahịa 3, ya mere ọ na-aghọ (x+1)(x+3), counterexample.
l-m-m3-b05-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna constant term 3 bụ prime, 1+3=4, ya mere ọ factors dịka (x+1)(x+3), nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b05-11.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “quadratic equation na-enwe ngwọta abụọ dị iche mgbe niile” bụ eziokwu, chọta ma kọwaa counterexample.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Nsonaazụ abụọ dị, 2 na 3, ya mere ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: Nsonaazụ abụọ dị, 3 na −2, ihe atụ dabara.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Nsonaazụ abụọ dị, 3 na −4, ihe atụ dabara.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s1.explain: x²−6x+9=(x−3)²=0, ya mere ngwọta bụ 3 naanị otu. Ọ bụghị ngwọta abụọ dị iche.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: x²−6x+9=(x−3)²=0, ya mere ngwọta bụ 3 naanị otu, enweghị ngwọta abụọ dị iche, ya mere counterexample.
l-m-m3-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Na (x−3)(x−3)=0, factors abụọ bụ otu, ya mere ngwọta bụ x=3 naanị otu, nkwupụta ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b05-23.title: Ọ bụrụ na tan A×tan B=1, A na B hà nhata?
l-m-m3-b05-23.goal: Kpebie ma echiche “ọ bụrụ na tan A×tan B=1, A na B bụ otu akụkụ” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile. Chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-egosi mgbe ọ na-abụghị eziokwu.
l-m-m3-b05-23.material: tan 30°=1/√3, tan 45°=1, tan 60°=√3. Echiche: ọ bụrụ na tan A×tan B=1, A na B bụ otu akụkụ. Chọta A na B ga-egosi na echiche a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 3, ya mere o mezughị ọnọdụ tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.c: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 1/3, ya mere o mezughị ọnọdụ tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.d: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 1, A na B hà nhata, ya mere ihe atụ a dabara n’echiche ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.explain: tan 30°×tan 60°=(1/√3)×√3=1, ma 30°≠60°. Akụkụ abụọ ọ bụla jikọtara bụrụ 90° na-enye ngwaahịa 1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: (1/√3)×√3=1, ya mere ọnọdụ ahụ mezuru; ma A=30° na B=60° bụ akụkụ dị iche iche, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha echiche ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: tan 30° na tan 60° bụ ibe ha n’ụdị ntụgharị, ya mere ngwaahịa ha bụ 1; ma akụkụ abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere echiche ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b05-36.title: Ọ bụrụ na nkezi karịrị, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ ọ na-abawanye kwa?
l-m-m3-b05-36.goal: Kpebie ma nkwupụta “data nwere nkezi ka ukwuu nwekwara ndapụ ọkọlọtọ ka ukwuu” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b05-36.material: Nkwupụta: Maka data A na B abụọ, nke nwere nkezi ka ukwuu nwekwara ndapụ ọkọlọtọ ka ukwuu. Chọta A na B na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s1.r.a: Nkezi 60 na 3, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10 na 1; ya mere ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi 20 na 6, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10 na 1; ya mere ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s1.r.d: Nkezi 30 na 9, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10 na 1; ya mere ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s1.explain: Nkezi A bụ 101, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 1; nke B bụ nkezi 5, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 4. A nwere nkezi ka ukwuu, ma B nwere ndapụ ọkọlọtọ ka ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s2.model.0: Nkezi A bụ 101, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 1; nke B bụ nkezi 5, ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 4. Nke nwere nkezi ka ukwuu nwere ndapụ ọkọlọtọ pere mpe, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-36.s.s2.model.1: Ndapụ ọkọlọtọ na-egosi etu uru si gbasasịa, nke dị iche na nha nkezi. Maka 100 na 102, nkezi dị ukwuu ma uru ha dị nso, ya mere ndapụ ọkọlọtọ pere mpe.

l-m-m3-b0s6-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ibulite ọnụọgụ ọ bụla n'ogo nke abụọ na-eme ka ọ buru ibu karịa ka ọ dị mgbe niile. Chọta ọnụọgụ na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b0s6-01.s.s1.r.b: (−2)²=4, 4>−2. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-01.s.s1.r.d: 10²=100, 100>10. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-01.s.s1.explain: (1/2)²=1/4, 1/4<1/2. Ọnụọgụ dị mma nke pere mpe karịa 1 na-adịkwa ntakịrị mgbe e buliri ya n'ogo nke abụọ.

l-m-m3-b0s6-02.title: Mgbe ị gbasasịrị (x+p)², ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x ọ na-adị mma mgbe niile?
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.goal: Kpebie ma nkwupụta “ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x n'ime (x+p)² na-adị mma mgbe niile” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ).
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe p bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-abụghị 0, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x na-adị mma mgbe niile mgbe a gbasasịrị (x+p)². Chọta ngosipụta na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ x²+14x+49, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, 14, dị mma. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ x²+8x+16, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, 8, dị mma. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ x²+2x+1, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, 2, dị mma. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s1.explain: (x−3)²=x²−6x+9, ya mere ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x bụ −6. Mgbe p dị njọ, ọnụọgụ 2p na-adịkwa njọ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s2.model.0: (x−3)²=x²−6x+9, ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, −6, adịghị mma. Ọnụọgụ ahụ adịghị mma, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-agbagha nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x na (x+p)² bụ 2p; ọ bụrụ na p bụ −3, ọ na-aghọ −6, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ dị mma na-adaba.

l-m-m3-b01-06.title: Gịnị ka a ga-ele anya iji mara ma maximum dị?
l-m-m3-b01-06.topic: Maximum na minimum nke quadratic function
l-m-m3-b01-06.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara ma function nwere maximum ma ọ bụ minimum, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b01-06.material: Ị chọrọ ịma ma quadratic function y=a(x−p)²+q nwere maximum ma ọ bụ minimum. Chee echiche ihe ga-ekpebi ụzọ eserese ahụ si meghee.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: Otu isi naanị anaghị ekpebi ụzọ o si meghee.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: q na-ekpebi naanị ịdị elu vertex. Ọ naghị egosi ụzọ eserese si meghee.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: p na-ekpebi naanị x-coordinate nke vertex, ọ naghị egosi ụzọ o si meghee.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ a>0, ọ na-emeghe elu ma nwee minimum; ọ bụrụ a<0, ọ na-emeghe ala ma nwee maximum.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ a dị mma ọ na-emeghe elu ma nwee minimum; ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njọ ọ na-emeghe ala ma nwee maximum. Ya mere ihe ịrịba ama a dị mkpa.
l-m-m3-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: p na q na-emegharị vertex naanị; a na-ekpebi ụzọ ọ si meghee, ya mere ịmara ihe ịrịba ama a ezuola.

l-m-m3-b01-07.title: Kedu ka esi atụnyere etu klas abụọ si gbasasịa?
l-m-m3-b01-07.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara otú akara klas abụọ si gbasasịa, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b01-07.material: Ị chọrọ iji tụnyere ma akara ule mgbakọ na mwepụ nke klas abụọ gbakọtara n’akụkụ mean ka ha gbasasịrị. Chee ozi dị mkpa.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.o.a: Akara onye nọ n’ọnọdụ 1 na klas nke ọ bụla
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Akara otu onye anaghị egosi otú akara onye ọ bụla si gbasasịa.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.o.b: Standard deviation nke klas nke ọ bụla
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Mean nke klas nke ọ bụla
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Mean na-egosi naanị etiti, ọ naghị egosi otú akara si gbasasịa.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.o.d: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ klas nke ọ bụla
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ naanị anaghị egosi otú akara si gbasasịa.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s1.explain: Ka standard deviation (ma ọ bụ variance) na-abawanye, ka akara si gbasasịa n’ebe dị anya site na mean.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Standard deviation na-egosi oke ọdịiche dị n’ozuzu; ya mere ọ na-enyere aka iji tụnyere mgbasasị klas abụọ.
l-m-m3-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma mean ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ hà nhata, akara nwere ike ịgbakọta nke ukwuu ma ọ bụ gbasaa; ya mere standard deviation dị mkpa maka ntụnyere.

l-m-m3-b01-08.title: Ogologo dị aṅaa ka achọrọ iji chọta sin A?
l-m-m3-b01-08.goal: Kpebie ozi dị mkpa iji chọta uru sin A n’ime right triangle, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b01-08.material: N’ime right triangle ABC, ∠C=90°. Ị chọrọ ịchọta sin A site n’ịmara ogologo abụọ naanị. Chee ogologo abụọ ị chọrọ.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị aṅaa dị mkpa iji chọta sin A?
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ dị n’akụkụ ∠A na akụkụ chere ya ihu
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Oke ahụ metụtara tan A, ọ bụghị sin A.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Oke ahụ bụ cos A, ọ bụghị sin A.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: Otu ogologo naanị ezughị iji mepụta ratio.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s1.explain: sin A=(akụkụ chere ihu ∠A)÷(hypotenuse). Ọ bụrụ na ị maara ogologo abụọ ndị a, sin A ga-ekpebi.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: sin A bụ ogologo akụkụ chere ihu kewara na hypotenuse; ya mere ị ga-amata ha abụọ.
l-m-m3-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji akụkụ dị n’akụkụ maka cos A, akụkụ dị n’akụkụ na nke chere ihu maka tan A; sin A chọrọ akụkụ chere ihu na hypotenuse.

l-m-m3-b01-09.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi mara ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza?
l-m-m3-b01-09.goal: Kpebie ozi dị mkpa iji chọpụta ọnụ ọgụgụ ezigbo azịza dị iche iche, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b01-09.material: Ị chọrọ ịma ọnụ ọgụgụ ezigbo azịza dị iche iche nke ax²+bx+c=0 n’enweghị idozi ya ozugbo. Olee ozi ị ga-elele?
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị aṅaa na-egosi ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza?
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.a: Ihe ịrịba ama a naanị anaghị ekpebi ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza.
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Ihe ịrịba ama c naanị anaghị ekpebi ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza.
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.d: a+b+c bụ uru a na-enweta mgbe etinyere x=1; o nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọnụọgụ azịza.
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ b²−4ac dị mma, azịza 2 dị; ma ọ bụrụ 0, azịza 1; ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njọ, azịza adịghị.
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: N’ime quadratic formula, ọnụ ọgụgụ azịza dabere ma b²−4ac dị n’okpuru square root dị mma, 0, ma ọ bụ njọ.
l-m-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ b²−4ac dị njọ, square root abụghị ezigbo, ya mere azịza adịghị. Ọ bụrụ dị mma, a na-eji akara ± abụọ ahụ, ya mere azịza 2 dị.

l-m-m3-b01-10.title: Gịnị bụ isi ihe iji gbanwee x²+bx+c ka ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa?
l-m-m3-b01-10.goal: Kpebie ozi dị mkpa iji chọta ọnọdụ nke x²+bx+c ga-aghọ (x+p)(x+q), kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b01-10.material: Ị chọrọ ịtọgbọ x²+bx+c n’ụdị (x+p)(x+q). Mgbe i gbasasịrị (x+p)(x+q), ị ga-ahụ ọnọdụ p na q ga-emezu.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnọdụ p na q ga-emezu?
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: p na q na-ekpebi site na nchikọta na ngwaahịa, ọ bụghị b na c n’onwe ha.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.b: E gbanwere nchikọta na ngwaahịa. Mgbe a gbasasịrị, coefficient x bụ p+q.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Coefficient x bụ p+q, ọ bụghị p−q.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: (x+p)(x+q)=x²+(p+q)x+pq; ya mere chọta ọnụọgụ abụọ nwere p+q=b na pq=c.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbasa (x+p)(x+q) na-enye x²+(p+q)x+pq; ya mere coefficient b nke x ga-abụ p+q, okwu na-adịgide c ga-abụ pq.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Tụnyere coefficient n’expression x²+bx+c, nchikọta ga-abụ b, ngwaahịa ga-abụ c; ya mere nchikọta na ngwaahịa nke ọnụọgụ abụọ bụ isi.

l-m-m3-b02-07.material: Anyị chọrọ ịma isi ole graph y=a(x−p)²+q zutere x-axis. Chee echiche ozi dị mkpa iji mara nke a n'enweghị eserese.
l-m-m3-b02-07.s.s1.r.b: p na-akwaga graph naanị aka ekpe ma ọ bụ aka nri, enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ọnụọgụ nzukọ.
l-m-m3-b02-07.s.s1.r.c: y-intercept naanị anaghị egosi ịdị elu vertex ma ọ bụ ntụziaka ọ na-emeghe.

l-m-m3-b02-07.s.s2.model.0: Akara a nke na-ekpebi ntụziaka oghere na akara q, ịdị elu vertex, na-egosi ma vertex dị n'elu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru x-axis, ya mere ọnụọgụ nzukọ kpebisiri ike.
l-m-m3-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: p na-akwaga graph aka ekpe ma ọ bụ aka nri naanị, ọnụọgụ nzukọ anaghị agbanwe, ya mere akara a na q naanị ka achọrọ.

l-m-m3-b02-10.title: Ịmata ma √n bụ natural number?
l-m-m3-b02-10.topic: Ọnọdụ square root ịbụ natural number
l-m-m3-b02-10.goal: Iji mara ma √n bụ natural number, họrọ ozi dị mkpa n'ezie, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b02-10.material: Maka natural number n, anyị chọrọ ịma ma √n bụ natural number. E dere n dịka ngwaahịa prime factors, dịka 12=2²×3, 36=2²×3², 200=2³×5².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi na-egosi ọnọdụ √n ịbụ natural number?
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.a: 36 na 12 abụọ nwere even ones digit, ma 36 naanị bụ square number.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.b: 9 na 15 abụọ bụ odd, ma 9 naanị bụ square number.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma exponents nke prime factors niile bụ even
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.d: Nha naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ọ bụ square number.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ exponents nke prime factors niile bụ even, n bụ square number, √n bụ natural number. 36 bụ 2²×3².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ exponents nke prime factors niile bụ even, enwere ike ide n dịka (nọmba)², ya mere √n bụ natural number.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: 12 nwere exponent 1 maka 3, 200 nwekwara exponent 3 maka 2, ya mere nke ọ bụla nwere odd exponent, nke pụtara √n abụghị natural number.

l-m-m3-b03-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ naanị angles ka ị maara, e nwere similar triangles na-enweghị ngwụcha, ya mere ị pụghị ikpebi ogologo.

l-m-m3-b03-07.goal: Kpebie criterion (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta quadratic function minimum ya dị na x=2, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b03-07.material: Ị chọrọ ka quadratic function y=a(x−p)²+q nwee minimum na x=2. Chee ọnọdụ ga-abụrịrị eziokwu.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.a: q bụ uru minimum. x ebe minimum dị bụ p.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ a<0, x=2 na-enye maximum, ọ bụghị minimum.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: a na q anaghị ekpebi ọnọdụ x ebe minimum dị.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.explain: Vertex dị na x=p, ọ bụrụ a>0, isi ahụ bụ minimum. Ya mere p=2, a>0.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: x ebe minimum ma ọ bụ maximum dị bụ x-coordinate p nke vertex, ọ bụ minimum ma ọ bụrụ a>0, ya mere p=2 na a>0 dị mkpa.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.1: Nha q na a enweghị ike ịgbanwe ọnọdụ minimum, ya mere p=2, a>0 na-arụ ọrụ, nke na-emeghe elu.

l-m-m3-b03-09.goal: Kpebie criterion (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa iji mata ma nọmba bụ irrational, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b03-09.material: Tọọ criterion iji kewaa nọmba ka ọ bụrụ rational na irrational. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, √4=2 bụ rational, √5 bụ irrational.
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu criterion ziri ezi ịhọrọ irrational numbers?
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụ irrational ma ọ bụrụ nwere ọtụtụ 0s mgbe decimal gachara
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ irrational ma ọ bụrụ nwere akara root
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ irrational ma ọ bụrụ non-repeating infinite decimal
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ irrational ma ọ bụrụ negative
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Irrational number bụ non-repeating infinite decimal nke enweghị ike ide dịka fraction.
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: Irrational number enweghị ike ide dịka fraction, ya mere mgbe e dere ya decimal ọ naghị akwụsị ma ọ naghị emegharị. Criterion a ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna nwere akara root, nọmba nwere ike ịbụ rational dịka √4, ya mere kpebie site n'ụdị decimal expression.

l-m-m3-b03-10.title: Kedu ka a ga-esi mara tupu idozi ma ngwọta bụ rational?
l-m-m3-b03-10.goal: Kpebie criterion (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara ma ngwọta quadratic equation nwere integer coefficients bụ rational, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b03-10.material: Tupu idozi ax²+bx+c=0 ebe coefficients niile bụ integers, ị chọrọ ịma tupu oge ma ngwọta ga-abụ rational ka akara root ga-adịgide.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị ga-enyocha tupu oge?
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma a bụ 1 ọ̀ dị mkpa?
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna mgbe a=1, azịza x²−2=0 bụ ±√2, nke bụ irrational.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.c: x²−3x+1=0 nwere c>0, mana azịza ya bụ irrational.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.d: x²−4x+1=0 nwere b even, mana azịza ya bụ irrational.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ b²−4ac dị n’okpuru akara mgbọrọgwụ na quadratic formula bụ perfect square, azịza bụ rational. Ma ọ bụghị ya, akara mgbọrọgwụ ga-adị.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: N’ime quadratic formula, ọ bụrụ b²−4ac dị n’okpuru root bụ perfect square, mgbọrọgwụ ga-apụ, azịza ghọọ rational; ya mere lelee nke a.
l-m-m3-b03-10.s.s2.model.1: Njirimara a, c na b naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma uru dị n’okpuru root ọ̀ bụ perfect square; ya mere lelee b²−4ac.

l-m-m3-b04-02.goal: Chọpụta ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji dee √72 n’ụdị kacha mfe, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b04-02.material: Ị chọrọ ide √72 n’ụdị dị mfe a√b. Chee otu esi ekewa 72 ka ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa ọnụọgụ abụọ.
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ka a ga-esi kewaa ya ka ọ dị mfe n’otu nzọụkwụ?
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-aghọ 2√18; square number 9 ka dị n’ime 18.
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: 6 ma ọ bụ 12 abụghị square number; ya mere e nweghị ihe a ga-ewepụ n’akara radical.
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s1.explain: Wepụ square number kacha ukwuu 36, dee √72=6√2; ọnụọgụ dị n’ime radical agaghị adị obere karịa.
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ i kewaa na 36, square number kacha ukwuu, √72=6√2; 2 enweghị ike ịdị mfe karịa.
l-m-m3-b04-02.s.s2.model.1: Na 8×9 ma ọ bụ 4×18, square number ka na-adị n’ime radical, a ga-eme ka ọ dị mfe ọzọ; ya mere 36×2 ka mma.

l-m-m3-b04-11.title: Ọnọdụ a ga-eji kpebie k n'ime x²−4x+k=0
l-m-m3-b04-11.goal: Chọpụta ihe ọmụma dị ezigbo mkpa iji kpebie k dịka otu uru n'ime x²−4x+k=0, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b04-11.material: Ị chọrọ ikpebi okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe k n'ime x²−4x+k=0 dịka otu uru. Chee echiche banyere ọnọdụ dị ezigbo mkpa.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnọdụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji kpebie k dịka otu uru?
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.a: Ọnọdụ na mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ dị mma
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Ọtụtụ uru 0<k≤4 ga-ekwe omume, ya mere ahọpụtaghị otu uru.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Ọnọdụ k bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Ọtụtụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dịka k=1, 2, 3 ga-ekwe omume.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.c: Ọnọdụ e nwere naanị otu mgbọrọgwụ (mgbọrọgwụ abụọ hà nhata)
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.d: Ọnọdụ ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, −4, bụ ọnụọgụ ekwe
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x bụ nke ekwe, a ka ekpebibeghị k.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe mgbọrọgwụ abụọ hà nhata, x²−4x+k=(x−2)², ya mere k=4. Ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ enweghị ike ikpebi otu uru k.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na mgbọrọgwụ abụọ hà nhata, ọ ga-abụrịrị (x−2)²=x²−4x+4, ya mere k bụ 4. Ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ezughị n'ihi na k nwere ọtụtụ uru.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere otu mgbọrọgwụ, discriminant 16−4k bụ 0, ya mere k=4. Ọnọdụ ịdị mma ma ọ bụ ịbụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-ekwe ka ọtụtụ k, ya mere ezughị.

l-m-m3-b04-16.topic: Ahịrị etiti nhata nke ọrụ quadratic
l-m-m3-b04-16.goal: Chọpụta ihe ọmụma dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta ahịrị etiti nhata nke y=ax²+bx+c, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b04-16.material: Eserese ọrụ quadratic y=ax²+bx+c hà nhata n'akụkụ aka ekpe na aka nri. Chee echiche banyere nke n'ime ọnụọgụ a, b, c dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara ọnọdụ ahịrị etiti nhata.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji kpebie ahịrị etiti nhata?
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: c na-egosi naanị ọnọdụ elu ma ọ bụ ala.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: c bụ y-intercept naanị, ọ naghị ekpebi axis of symmetry.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị b, ị pụghị ịma ọnọdụ axis of symmetry.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Axis of symmetry bụ x=−b/(2a). A na-ekpebi ya site na a na b, c adịghị mkpa.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: a na b naanị ka a na-etinye n'ime x=−b/(2a), ya mere coefficients abụọ a dị mkpa n'ezie, c adịghị.
l-m-m3-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: c na-akwaga graph elu ma ọ bụ ala naanị, axis of symmetry na-adị otu. Ya mere a na b dị mkpa iji kpebie ya.

l-m-m3-b04-26.title: Ịmara anya n'etiti isi abụọ
l-m-m3-b04-26.goal: Chọpụta criterion (ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta anya n'etiti isi abụọ na coordinate plane, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b04-26.material: Ị chọrọ ịchọta anya n'etiti isi abụọ na coordinate plane. Chee ozi naanị ga-eme ka ị jiri Pythagorean theorem chọta ya.
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s1.r.a: Ngụkọta enweghị ike ịgwa ọdịiche kwụ ọtọ na vetikal n'etiti isi abụọ.
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s1.o.b: Quadrant isi abụọ nọ na ya
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s1.r.b: Ị pụghị ịchọta anya site na quadrants naanị.
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s1.r.c: Ịmara akara naanị anaghị ekpebi anya.
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s1.explain: Ọdịiche kwụ ọtọ na vetikal ghọọ akụkụ abụọ nke right triangle, ya mere anya bụ √(horizontal²+vertical²).
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s2.model.0: Ị nwere ike ime right triangle site n'iji ọdịiche kwụ ọtọ na vetikal dịka akụkụ abụọ, ya mere a na-achọta anya dịka √(horizontal²+vertical²).
l-m-m3-b04-26.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta ma ọ bụ quadrants anaghị egosi oghere n'etiti isi abụọ, ya mere ọdịiche coordinates dị mkpa n'ezie.

l-m-m3-b04-32.goal: Chọpụta ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta ọnọdụ etiti okirikiri, kọwakwa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b04-32.material: Ọnụ efere okirikiri gbajiri agbaji ka dị. Iji chọta etiti efere mbụ, chee ozi ị chọrọ mgbe ị na-adọta chords n’akụkụ ọnụ ya.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị dị mkpa iji dozie etiti dịka otu isi?
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ naanị otu ahịrị; ya mere ọnọdụ etiti adịghị edozi dịka otu isi.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo naanị anaghị agwa ọnọdụ etiti.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.o.c: Perpendicular bisector nke chord abụọ na-abụghị parallel
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.o.d: Perpendicular bisector nke chord abụọ parallel
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị abụọ ahụ dakwasịrị ibe ha; ya mere otu isi adịghị edozi.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s1.explain: Perpendicular bisector nke chord na-agafe n’etiti. Ọ bụrụ chord abụọ adịghị parallel, ahịrị abụọ ahụ na-ezukọ n’otu isi.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s2.model.0: Ebe perpendicular bisector nke chord na-agafe etiti, chord abụọ na-abụghị parallel na-eme ka ahịrị abụọ ahụ zute n’otu isi, nke bụ etiti.
l-m-m3-b04-32.s.s2.model.1: Maka chord abụọ parallel, perpendicular bisector bụ otu ahịrị; ya mere otu isi adịghị edozi. Otu chord kwa bụ naanị otu ahịrị, ya mere ahịrị abụọ ga-ezukọ.

l-m-m3-b05-02.title: Ngụkọ Iwepụ Root Sign na 2/√3
l-m-m3-b05-02.goal: Chọpụta criteria (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa maka ngụkọ na-ewepụ root sign na denominator nke 2/√3, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ha.
l-m-m3-b05-02.material: Ị chọrọ iwepụ root sign na denominator nke 2/√3. Chee ngụkọ dị mkpa iji wepụ root sign naanị ma uru ahụ dịrị otu.
l-m-m3-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Uru na-aghọ √3 ugboro ka ukwuu, root sign na denominator ka dị.
l-m-m3-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Denominator na-aghọ 2√3, root sign ka dị.
l-m-m3-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ i mụbaa numerator na denominator na otu √3, uru na-adị otu, denominator na-aghọ 3. Ọ bụ 2√3/3.
l-m-m3-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: Iji mee denominator √3×√3=3, ị ga-amụba na √3, ka uru ghara ịgbanwe, mụbaa numerator na ya kwa.
l-m-m3-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ i mụbaa denominator naanị, uru fraction na-agbanwe, ya mere mụbaa numerator na denominator n'otu √3 ka ọ bụrụ 2√3/3.

l-m-m3-b05-12.title: Enwere ike iji factoring dozie x²+3x+1=0?
l-m-m3-b05-12.goal: Chọpụta criteria (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara ma enwere ike iji factoring dozie x²+3x+1=0, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ha.
l-m-m3-b05-12.material: Ị chọrọ ịma ma x²+3x+1=0 nwere ike ime factoring ka ọ bụrụ (x+a)(x+b)=0. Chee criteria a ga-enyocha.
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu criterion na-ekpebi ma ọ ga-ekwe omume?
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.r.a: E nwere expressions na-enweghị ike factoring ọbụna coefficients ha positive.
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.o.b: Ma enwere integer abụọ ngwaahịa ha bụ 1, ngụkọta 3
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.r.c: E nwere expressions na-enweghị ike factoring ọbụna coefficient bụ 1.
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.r.d: E nwere expressions nwere ike ime factoring ọbụna ma ọ bụ odd (x²+5x+6).
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s1.explain: Integer pairs nwere ngwaahịa 1 bụ (1,1) na (−1,−1), ngụkọta ha abụghị 3, ya mere enweghị ike factoring n'ime integers.
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s2.model.0: Maka (x+a)(x+b), anyị chọrọ ab=1 na a+b=3, ma enweghị integer pair dị otu a, ya mere enweghị ike idozi site factoring.
l-m-m3-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Integer abụọ naanị nwere ngwaahịa 1 bụ 1 na 1, ma ọ bụ −1 na −1, ngụkọta enweghị ike ịbụ 3, ya mere site na criterion a ọ gaghị ekwe omume.

l-m-m3-b0s6-03.title: Kedu ihe ị ga-elele ka ọ bụrụ nhatanha quadratic?
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọta ọnọdụ k ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ nhatanha quadratic, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.material: k bụ ọnụọgụ na-enweghị mgbanwe. Anyị chọrọ ịchọta ọnọdụ k ka (k−2)x²+3x+1=0 bụrụ nhatanha quadratic na x. Chee echiche ihe a ga-elele.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị ga-elele iji chọta ọnọdụ k?
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe bụ 0, ọ ka bụ nhatanha quadratic ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere okwu x².
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ ngwọta bụ ihe a na-atụle mgbe ọ ghọchara nhatanha quadratic.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x², k−2, abụghị 0
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x, 3, abụghị 0
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 abụghị 0 ugbua; ma ọ bụ quadratic ka ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x² na-ekpebi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x², k−2, bụ 0, ọ na-aghọ nhatanha linear. Ya mere k−2≠0, ya bụ k≠2.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na k=2, okwu x² na-apụ, ọ na-aghọ 3x+1=0; ya mere anyị ga-elele na ọnụọgụ x², k−2, abụghị 0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s2.model.1: Nhatanha quadratic chọrọ okwu x², ya mere naanị ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x² dị mkpa; ọnụọgụ ndị ọzọ na ọnụ ọgụgụ ngwọta adịghị mkpa.

l-m-m3-b0s6-04.topic: Ihe ga-egosi iji usoro ọdịiche square
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.goal: Kpebie ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji mata ngosipụta ndị a pụrụ itinye ihe ọnụ site na a²−b², kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.material: Anyị chọrọ itinye ihe ọnụ site na a²−b²=(a+b)(a−b). Chee echiche banyere ihe ga-egosi ngosipụta ndị dabara na usoro a.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ga-egosi ngosipụta ndị nwere ike iji usoro a?
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ niile dị n'ihu ha bụ 1
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.a: 4x²−9 bụkwa (2x)²−3², ya mere ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'ihu ha ekwesịghị ịbụ 1.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.b: Okwu abụọ ahụ bụ square nke ngosipụta ụfọdụ, ma e nwere mwepụ n'etiti ha
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.c: Okwu abụọ ahụ bụ square nke ngosipụta ụfọdụ, ma e nwere mgbakwunye n'etiti ha
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.c: Ngụkọta dịka x²+9 enweghị ike ịbụ (a+b)(a−b).
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.d: Okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe bụ ọnụọgụ ekwe
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.d: Ma okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe ọ̀ bụ ekwe enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na usoro ahụ. x²−9 nwere okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe na-adịghị ekwe.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.explain: a²−b² bụ ọdịiche nke okwu abụọ bụ square. 4x²−9=(2x)²−3² nwekwara ụdị a, ya mere ọ na-aghọ (2x+3)(2x−3).
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s2.model.0: Okwu abụọ ahụ ga-abụ square, nwee mwepụ n'etiti ha ka e wee dee ya dịka (a+b)(a−b). Ọ bụrụ na e nwere mgbakwunye, a pụghị ide ya dịka ngwaahịa, ya mere ịbụ ọdịiche bụ ihe ga-egosi ya.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s2.model.1: 4x²−9 bụ (2x)²−3², ya mere ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'ihu ha ekwesịghị ịbụ 1. Ihe ga-egosi ya bụ ma ọ̀ bụ ọdịiche square, ya mere okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe ekwe ma ọ bụ na-adịghị ekwe adịghị mkpa.

l-m-m3-b01-11.material: (x+1)²=x²+2x+1, (x+2)²=x²+4x+4, (x+3)²=x²+6x+9, (x+4)²=x²+8x+16. Chọta usoro coefficient na okwu na-adịgide ka n na-agbanwe.

l-m-m3-b01-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nke nhatanha eserese ebe isi ọnụ nọ, chọta ma kwupụta usoro ahụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.
l-m-m3-b01-12.material: Isi ọnụ nke y=(x−1)²+1, y=(x−2)²+4 na y=(x−3)²+9 bụ (1, 1), (2, 4) na (3, 9). Chọta usoro dị n'etiti nhazi abụọ nke isi ọnụ ndị a.
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ nhatanha eserese ebe isi ọnụ atọ ahụ niile nọ?
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.a: Na x=2 ọ na-enye 3, ya mere (2, 4) adabaghị.
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.c: Na x=3 ọ na-enye 7, ya mere (3, 9) adabaghị.
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: Na x=1 ọ na-enye 3, ya mere (1, 1) adabaghị.
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Nhazi y bụ square nke nhazi x. 1=1², 4=2², 9=3², ya mere y=x².
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: Nhazi y 1, 4, 9 bụ square nke nhazi x 1, 2, 3, ya mere isi ọnụ niile nọ na y=x².
l-m-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Mmụba y bụ 3 na 5, na-abawanye, ya mere ọ bụghị ahịrị kwụ ọtọ kama ọ dị n'ụdị y=x².

l-m-m3-b01-14.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ uru sin²A+cos²A, chọta ma kwupụta usoro ahụ, wee nwalee ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b01-14.material: Mgbe A=30°, sin²A=0.25, cos²A=0.75. Mgbe A=45°, ha bụ 0.5 na 0.5; mgbe A=60°, ha bụ 0.75 na 0.25. Chọta usoro dị na nchikọta square abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe A=20°, gịnị bụ uru sin²A+cos²A?
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.a: 0.25 bụ naanị uru sin²A mgbe 30°, ọ bụghị nchikọta ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dịghị ọnọdụ nwere nchikọta 0.5. Ọnọdụ atọ ahụ niile na-enye 1.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dịghị ọnọdụ nwere nchikọta 2. Ọnọdụ atọ ahụ niile na-enye 1.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Maka 30°, 45° na 60°, nchikọta ahụ bụ 1 oge ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụgodị na akụkụ nkuku dị iche, sin²A+cos²A=1.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ nkuku atọ ahụ niile na-enye nchikọta 1 (0.25+0.75, 0.5+0.5, 0.75+0.25), ya mere anyị nwere ike ikwu na ọ ga-abụkwa 1 mgbe 20°.
l-m-m3-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna mgbe akụkụ nkuku dị iche, nchikọta square abụọ ahụ bụ 1 mgbe niile; ya mere mgbe A=20° kwa, sin²A+cos²A=1.

l-m-m3-b01-15.title: Gịnị ga-abụ √n×√(4n)?
l-m-m3-b01-15.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ uru √n×√(4n), chọta ma kwupụta usoro ahụ, wee nwalee ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b01-15.material: √2×√8=4, √3×√12=6, √5×√20=10. Chọta usoro dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ mbụ n na uru ngwaahịa ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Iji usoro ahụ, gịnị bụ uru √7×√28?
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: 49 bụ n². Mgbe n=3, nke ahụ ga-abụ 9, ma ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 6, ya mere ọ dabaghị.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: 196 bụ ngwaahịa dị n'okpuru akara mgbọrọgwụ. Ị kwesịrị iwepụta mgbọrọgwụ square ya.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Ngwaahịa ahụ abụghị 28. Ọ bụ 2 e mụbara na n, dịka 2×2, 2×3, 2×5.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 2 e mụbara na n. 4=2×2, 6=2×3, 10=2×5, ya mere √7×√28=14.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Ngwaahịa 4, 6, 10 bụ 2 e mụbara na n=2, 3, 5; ya mere maka n=7 ọ bụ 14. √7×√28=√196=14 na-akwado ya.
l-m-m3-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: √(4n)=2√n, ya mere √n×2√n=2n, nke pụtara na mgbe n=7 ọ bụ 14.

l-m-m3-b02-11.title: Iwu positive root nke x²+x−k=0
l-m-m3-b02-11.topic: Ngwakọta natural numbers na-esochi ibe ha
l-m-m3-b02-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ positive root nke x²+x−k=0, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b02-11.material: Positive root nke x²+x−6=0 bụ 2, nke x²+x−12=0 bụ 3, nke x²+x−20=0 bụ 4. Constant terms 6, 12, 20 bụ 2×3, 3×4, 4×5. Chọta iwu.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.prompt: Dịka iwu ahụ si dị, gịnị bụ positive root nke x²+x−42=0?
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.b: 42 bụ constant term, ọ bụghị root.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: 7 bụ nọmba ka ukwuu n'ime ngwaahịa 6×7. Positive root bụ nke nta, 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: −7 bụ negative root. Ajụjụ jụrụ positive root.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ k bụ n×(n+1), positive root bụ n. Ebe 42=6×7, positive root bụ 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Constant terms 6, 12, 20 bụ 2×3, 3×4, 4×5, positive roots bụ nọmba nta 2, 3, 4, ya mere maka 42=6×7, azịza bụ 6.
l-m-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Ebe (x+7)(x−6)=x²+x−42 ziri ezi, positive root bụ 6.

l-m-m3-b02-13.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ standard deviation nke data ebe a mụbara uru niile n'otu nọmba ahụ, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b02-13.material: Standard deviation nke data 2, 4, 6, 8 bụ √5. Mgbe a mụbara uru ọ bụla na 2, standard deviation bụ 2√5; mgbe a mụbara uru niile na 3, ọ bụ 3√5. Chọta iwu.
l-m-m3-b02-13.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ a mụbaa uru niile na 5, standard deviation ga-abụ ugboro ole nke mbụ?

l-m-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: Ugboro 25 bụ mgbanwe variance. Standard deviation na-aghọ ugboro 5.
l-m-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ i mụbaa uru, mgbasa na-agbanwe kwa.
l-m-m3-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ a mụbaa uru niile na k, deviations na-amụbakwa na k, ya mere standard deviation na-aghọ ugboro k, variance na-aghọ ugboro k².

l-m-m3-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Deviations na-aghọkwa ugboro 5 yana uru, ya mere standard deviation nke na-egosi nha deviations na-aghọkwa ugboro 5.

l-m-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Tan values nke angles abụọ na-agbakọta 90° bụ reciprocals ibe ha, ya mere ngwaahịa bụ 1.

l-m-m3-b03-14.topic: Axis symmetry na otu uru y
l-m-m3-b03-14.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo usoro sitere n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke x abụọ nwere otu y na y=x²−2x, jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b03-14.material: N’ime y=x²−2x, mgbe x=−1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y bụ 3, 0, −1, 0, 3. Chọta usoro n’ụzọ abụọ x nwere otu y.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s1.prompt: N’iji usoro ahụ, kedu x ọzọ nwere otu uru y na x=5?
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.a: x=1 bụ vertex, ya mere o nweghị onye ọzọ.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.c: x nwere otu uru y na x=3 bụ x=−1.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: Etiti symmetry bụ x=1, ọ bụghị x=0.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta x abụọ nwere otu y bụ 2 (axis symmetry x=1). Onye kwekọrọ na 5 bụ 2−5=−3.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Dịka ụzọ (0, 2) na (−1, 3), nchikọta x abụọ nwere otu y bụ 2; onye kwekọrọ na 5 bụ −3.
l-m-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: X abụọ ahụ dị otu anya n’aka ekpe na aka nri nke x=1; onye kwekọrọ na 5 bụ −3, nke dị 4 n’aka ekpe nke 1.

l-m-m3-b03-15.goal: Chọpụta usoro sitere n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ ka akụkụ na-abawanye 20° oge ọ bụla, kwuo ya ma jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b03-15.material: sin 10°≈0.17, sin 30°≈0.50, sin 50°≈0.77, sin 70°≈0.94. Mgbe akụkụ mụbara 20° oge ọ bụla, sin mụbara 0.33, 0.27, 0.17.

l-m-m3-b03-15.s.s1.r.b: I chere na mmụba ahụ bụ otu. Usoro ya bụ na mmụba na-ebelata.
l-m-m3-b03-15.s.s1.r.c: Ọ naghị abawanye dịka na mbụ. Ogo mmụba na-ebelata nwayọọ nwayọọ.

l-m-m3-b04-03.title: Usoro digit na square root ka ọnụọgụ 0 na-abawanye
l-m-m3-b04-03.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo usoro n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ ka uru square root si eto, jiri ihe atụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b04-03.material: √100=10, √10000=100, √1000000=1000. Chọta usoro n’etiti ọnụ ọgụgụ 0 dị n’ime radical na ọnụ ọgụgụ 0 dị na square root.
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s1.prompt: N’iji usoro ahụ, gịnị bụ uru √100000000? (1 sochiri 8 0s)
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ị were ọnụ ọgụgụ 0 dịka 6 kama ọkara ya.
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ uru mgbe e nwere 6 0s. Maka 8 0s, e nwere otu ọzọ.
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s1.explain: Mgbe 0 na-abawanye na 2, 0 dị na square root na-abawanye na 1. Maka 8 0s, root bụ 10000, nke nwere 4 0s.
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe 0 bụ 2, 4, 6, 0 dị na root bụ 1, 2, 3, ya bụ ọkara. Maka 8, ọ bụ 4; azịza bụ 10000.
l-m-m3-b04-03.s.s2.model.1: Oge ọ bụla agbakwunyere 0 abụọ n’okpuru radical, root na-enweta 0 ọzọ; ya mere √100000000=10000.

l-m-m3-b04-09.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta usoro site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ uru a na-enweta site n'ịgbakwunye ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu n'ime ọnụọgụ eke abụọ na-esote ibe ha na ngwaahịa ha, wee nwalee usoro ahụ na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b04-09.material: 2×3+3=9, 3×4+4=16, 4×5+5=25. Chọta usoro maka uru a na-enweta site n'ịgbakwunye nke ka ukwuu n'ime ọnụọgụ eke abụọ na-esote ibe ha na ngwaahịa ha.
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s1.prompt: Iji usoro ahụ, gịnị bụ uru 10×11+11?
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ uru mgbe ị gbakwụnyere naanị 1, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu 11.
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ 11×12. Ị bugharịrị ọnụọgụ abụọ a ga-eji mụbaa otu ebe.
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s1.r.d: Ị chọtara naanị ngwaahịa, i tinyeghị ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu 11.
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s2.model.0: 9, 16 na 25 bụ 3², 4² na 5², ya bụ square nke ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu; ya mere 10×11+11=11²=121.
l-m-m3-b04-09.s.s2.model.1: Iwepụta (n+1) dịka ihe jikọrọ ọnụ na-enye (n+1)(n+1), ya bụ 121, square nke ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu 11.

l-m-m3-b04-22.title: Pairs angles ebe sin na cos values hà nhata
l-m-m3-b04-22.goal: Chọta ma kwuo usoro site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ pairs angles ebe sin na cos values hà nhata, jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b04-22.material: sin 30°=cos 60°, sin 45°=cos 45°, sin 60°=cos 30°. Lelee nha angles, chọta usoro dị n'etiti sin na cos.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.prompt: Dịka usoro ahụ si dị, gịnị hà nhata sin 20°?
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.r.a: Ị jikọtara 20° na ya onwe ya. Chọta angle ngụkọta ya bụ 90°.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.r.b: Ị jikọtara ha n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ka angles abụọ gbakọta 180°.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.r.c: tan nwere usoro values dị iche na sin.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s1.explain: Mgbe angles abụọ gbakọtara 90°, sin A=cos(90°−A). sin 20°=cos 70°.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: Angles abụọ na-agbakọta 90°, dịka 30° na 60°, 45° na 45°, ya mere sin 20° hà nhata cos 70°.
l-m-m3-b04-22.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta angle sin na angle cos na-enye 90° mgbe niile, ya mere onye kwekọrọ na 20° bụ 70°.

l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: N’iji otu iwu ahụ, mgbe akụkụ kacha mkpụmkpụ bụ 9, gịnị bụ akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ?
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.r.a: Ha bụ ọnụọgụ na-esochi ibe ha, mana 9²+10²≠11².
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ha anaghị eso ibe ha, nchikọta square adịghịkwa arụ ọrụ.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Ị were n²−1 na n² dịka akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ. Ị ga-ekewa na 2.
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ kacha mkpụmkpụ bụ n, akụkụ ndị ọzọ bụ (n²−1)/2 na (n²+1)/2. Mgbe n=9, ha bụ 40 na 41, 9²+40²=41².
l-m-m3-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Kpọọ square nke akụkụ kacha mkpụmkpụ, wepụ 1, kewaa na 2 iji nweta akụkụ; tinye 1 ma kewaa na 2 maka hypotenuse. Maka 9, ha bụ 40 na 41.

l-m-m3-b04-33.title: Akụkụ ndị na-emegide n’ime quadrilateral e sere n’okirikiri
l-m-m3-b04-33.goal: Chọta iwu sitere n’ọtụtụ ikpe nke akụkụ abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n’ime quadrilateral e sere n’okirikiri, kwuo ya ma jiri ikpe ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b04-33.material: N’ime quadrilateral ABCD e sere n’okirikiri, a tụrụ ∠A na ∠C na-emegide ya. Ha bụ (70°, 110°), (95°, 85°), (120°, 60°).
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.prompt: N’iji iwu ahụ, ma ∠A=65°, gịnị bụ ∠C?
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.r.b: I chere nchikọta bụ 90°. Nchikọta bụ 180°.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.r.c: I chere akụkụ ndị na-emegide hà nhata.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta akụkụ abụọ na-emegide bụ 180° mgbe niile. 180°−65°=115°.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s2.model.0: 70+110, 95+85, 120+60 niile bụ 180; ya mere nchikọta akụkụ abụọ na-emegide bụ 180°, ∠C=115°.
l-m-m3-b04-33.s.s2.model.1: N’ime ikpe atọ niile nchikọta bụ 180°, ya mere iwu bụ 180°; akụkụ kwekọrọ na 65° bụ 180°−65°=115°.

l-m-m3-b05-03.title: Ọnụọgụ Natural Numbers n'etiti Square Numbers
l-m-m3-b05-03.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ ọnụọgụ natural numbers n'etiti neighboring square numbers, kwuo ya ma jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b05-03.material: N'etiti 1 na 4 e nwere natural numbers 2, ya bụ 2 na 3. N'etiti 4 na 9 e nwere 4, n'etiti 9 na 16 e nwere 6. Chọta iwu n'etiti order square numbers na ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.prompt: Dịka iwu ahụ si dị, natural numbers ole dị n'etiti 25 na 36?
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.r.b: Ị were 5, square root nke 25, dị ka ọnụ ọgụgụ.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.r.c: Ị were n n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ka ọ bụrụ 6, mee 2×6.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.r.d: Ị jiri 36−25=11 kpọmkwem. Ị ga-ewepụ nọmba njedebe abụọ.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s1.explain: N'etiti n² na (n+1)² e nwere nọmba 2n. 25=5², ya mere 2×5=10 (26 ruo 35).
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: Nọmba 1, 2, 3 tupu 2², 3², 4² mụbara na 2 na-enye 2, 4, 6, ya mere n'etiti 5² na 6² bụ 2×5=10.
l-m-m3-b05-03.s.s2.model.1: Nọmba n'etiti na-aga site n²+1 ruo (n+1)²−1, ya mere ọnụ ọgụgụ bụ 2n, n'etiti 25 na 36 e nwere 10.

l-m-m3-b05-09.title: Ịchọta Iwu n'Ọdịiche Neighboring Squares
l-m-m3-b05-09.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ ọdịiche squares nke natural numbers abụọ na-esochi ibe ha, kwuo ya, jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-m3-b05-09.material: 2²−1²=3, 3²−2²=5, 4²−3²=7, 5²−4²=9. Chọta iwu n'ọdịiche squares nke natural numbers abụọ na-esochi ibe ha.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s1.prompt: Dịka iwu ahụ si dị, uru 20²−19² bụ ole?
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ uru 21²−20². 20²−19² bu nzọụkwụ tupu ya.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ uru 20−19. Ọ bụghị ọdịiche squares.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ugboro 2 nke 20. Ị ga-agbakwunye 1 na ugboro 2 nke 19.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s1.explain: (n+1)²−n²=2n+1. Mgbe n=19, ọ bụ 39, 20+19=39 bụkwa ngụkọta nọmba abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: 3, 5, 7, na 9 hà nhata ngụkọta nọmba abụọ agbata obi, ya mere 20²−19²=20+19=39.
l-m-m3-b05-09.s.s2.model.1: Ebe (n+1)²−n²=(n+1+n)×1, ọ na-aghọ ngụkọta nọmba abụọ, ya mere 20+19=39.

l-m-m3-b05-18.title: Ịmata ọrụ quadratic site n’iche dị n’etiti uru ọrụ
l-m-m3-b05-18.goal: Chọpụta iwu site n’otú uru ọrụ si agbanwe n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ọrụ quadratic, kwuo iwu ahụ ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b05-18.material: N’ọrụ quadratic, mgbe x=0, 1, 2, 3, uru y bụ 1, 2, 5, 10. Lee ọdịiche dị n’etiti uru y ndị na-esochi iji chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na anyị ejiri otu iwu ahụ, gịnị bụ y mgbe x=5?
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s1.r.a: I chere na ọdịiche ahụ anaghị agbanwe (+4). Ma ọdịiche ahụ na-abawanye mgbe niile.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s1.r.b: I chọtara x² naanị, i tinyekwanụghị 1.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s1.r.d: I gara n’ihu na ọdịiche ahụ dị ka 7, ma ọdịiche site na 4 ruo 5 bụ 9.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s1.explain: Ọdịiche dị na y bụ 1, 3, 5, 7, na-abawanye 2 oge ọbụla. Mgbe x=4, y=17; tinye ọdịiche ọzọ 9 ka y bụrụ 26 mgbe x=5.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọdịiche dị na y bụ 1, 3, 5, na-abawanye 2 oge ọbụla. Ya mere ndị na-esote bụ 7 na 9; 10+7=17, 17+9=26.
l-m-m3-b05-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọdịiche dị n’etiti ọdịiche ndị ahụ na-adịgide 2, ya mere ọrụ ahụ bụ y=x²+1. Mgbe x=5, 25+1=26.

l-m-m3-b05-28.topic: Triangle pụrụ iche nwere akụkụ ziri ezi
l-m-m3-b05-28.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke akụkụ na ịdị elu triangle nwere akụkụ atọ hà nhata, kwuo iwu ị hụrụ ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b05-28.material: Triangle ndị nwere akụkụ 2, 4 na 6 nwere ịdị elu √3, 2√3 na 3√3. Chọta iwu jikọtara ogologo akụkụ na ịdị elu.
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na e jiri otu iwu ahụ, gịnị bụ ịdị elu triangle nwere akụkụ 10?
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-amụba ọkara ogologo akụkụ ahụ na √3, ọ bụghị ogologo ya dum.
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọkara ogologo akụkụ ahụ. I mụbaghị ya na √3.
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s1.explain: Ịdị elu bụ ọkara akụkụ ahụ mụbaa na √3. 10÷2=5, ya mere ọ bụ 5√3.
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s2.model.0: 2→√3, 4→2√3, 6→3√3; ya mere iwu ahụ bụ ịmụba ọkara ogologo akụkụ na √3. Maka 10, ọ bụ 5√3.
l-m-m3-b05-28.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ịdị elu bụ ọkara akụkụ × √3, akụkụ 10 na-enye 5√3, nke dị ihe dị ka 8.66.

l-m-m3-b05-38.title: Iwu maka mgbanwe gbasasịrị mgbe a gbanwere uru data
l-m-m3-b05-38.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ ihe na-eme mgbanwe gbasasịrị mgbe a gbanwere uru niile dị na data, kwupụta iwu ị chọtara, wee nwalee ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b05-38.material: Data 1, 3 nwere nkezi 2 na mgbanwe gbasasịrị 1. Ịmụba ihe niile na 2 na-enye 2, 6, nkezi 4, mgbanwe gbasasịrị 4; ịgbakwunye 5 n'ihe niile na-enye 6, 8, nkezi 7, mgbanwe gbasasịrị 1.
l-m-m3-b05-38.s.s1.prompt: Iji otu iwu ahụ, gịnị bụ mgbanwe gbasasịrị ma i jiri 3 mụbaa 1, 3?
l-m-m3-b05-38.s.s1.r.a: Mgbanwe gbasasịrị na-abụ okpukpu 3², ọ bụghị okpukpu 3.
l-m-m3-b05-38.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-adị otu naanị mgbe ị gbakwụnyere. Ịmụba na-agbanwe ya.
l-m-m3-b05-38.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ nkezi 3 na 9. Ọ bụghị mgbanwe gbasasịrị.

l-m-m3-b0s6-05.topic: Mgbọrọgwụ n'ime denominator na ime ka irighiri ọnụọgụ dị mfe
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ uru k/√k, kwupụta iwu ị chọtara, wee nwalee ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.material: 2/√2=√2, 3/√3=√3, 5/√5=√5, 7/√7=√7. Lelee mmekọrịta dị n'etiti numerator k na denominator √k, chọta iwu ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe e jiri iwu ahụ mee 11/√11, gịnị bụ uru ya?
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na 11/√11 bụ 11, √11 ga-abụrịrị 1. E wepụrụ denominator ahụ n'amaghị ama.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ njehie e mere ka numerator 11 banye n'okpuru mgbọrọgwụ dịka ọ ghọrọ 1.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ uru e nwetara site n'ime ka denominator nke 1/√11 ghọọ ọnụọgụ ezi uche. Numerator abụghị 11.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s2.model.0: Ebe k=√k×√k, na k/√k a na-akagbu √k, √k fọdụrụ. Otu ihe ahụ metụtara 11/√11, ya bụ √11.
l-m-m3-b0s6-05.s.s2.model.1: Uru maka 2, 3, 5, 7 bụ √k niile; ya mere iwu bụ k/√k=√k, 11/√11=√11.

l-m-m3-b0s6-06.title: Iwu a chọtara n'ngwọta x²−nx=0
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ọnọdụ ngwọta x²−nx=0, kwupụta iwu ị chọtara, wee nwalee ya na ọnọdụ ọhụrụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.material: Ngwọta x²−x=0 bụ 0 na 1; nke x²−2x=0 bụ 0 na 2; nke x²−3x=0 bụ 0 na 3. x²−5x=0 na-enyekwa 0 na 5. Chọta iwu dị n'etiti ngwọta na n.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ngwọta mgbe e jiri iwu ahụ mee x²−7x=0?
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ngwọta nke e nwetara site n'ikekọrịta akụkụ abụọ na x, nke tụfuru x=0. x=0 bụkwa ngwọta.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.r.c: x²−7x=x(x−7), ya mere ọ bụ 7, ọ bụghị −7.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na i tinye x=1, ị ga-enweta 1−7=−6, nke na-abụghị 0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s1.explain: x²−nx=x(x−n)=0, ya mere ngwọta bụ 0 na n. Maka x²−7x=0, ha bụ 0 na 7.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s2.model.0: x²−nx=x(x−n), ya mere x=0 ma ọ bụ x=n. Ọnọdụ 1, 2, 3 na 5 dabara na iwu ahụ, maka n=7 ngwọta bụ 0 na 7.
l-m-m3-b0s6-06.s.s2.model.1: N'ọnọdụ niile, ngwọta bụ 0 na n; ya mere x²−7x=0 nwekwara ngwọta 0 na 7. Itinye 7 na-enye 49−49=0, nke na-akwado ya.

l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Ị gbakwụnyere 3+10. Ị ga-agbakwunye √10, ọ bụghị 10.

l-m-m3-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Ị gaa √10 n’aka nri site na 3, x-coordinate vertex; ya mere ihe dịka 3+3.2, bụ 6.2.

l-m-m3-b04-12.title: Ime atụmatụ mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu nke x²−5x+3=0
l-m-m3-b04-12.goal: Mee atụmatụ mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu nke x²−5x+3=0, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b04-12.material: Ị chọrọ ime atụmatụ mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu nke x²−5x+3=0. Uru ngosipụta ahụ bụ −3 mgbe x=3, −1 mgbe x=4, 0.75 mgbe x=4.5, 3 mgbe x=5.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s1.prompt: Mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu dị ihe dị ka ebee?
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe x=3 na 4, uru ha abụọ bụ nke na-adịghị mma, ya mere akara ya anaghị agbanwe.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe x=4.5, uru ya adịlarị mma, ya mere mgbọrọgwụ pere mpe karịa 4.5.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe x=5 uru ya bụ +3, ọ na-anọgide na-abawanye, ya mere enweghị mgbọrọgwụ gafere 5.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s1.explain: Akara na-agbanwe site na −1 mgbe x=4 gaa na 0.75 mgbe x=4.5, ya mere mgbọrọgwụ ka ukwuu dị n'etiti 4 na 4.5.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: Uru ya bụ −1 mgbe x=4 na 0.75 mgbe x=4.5, akara na-agbanwe, nke pụtara na mgbọrọgwụ dị n'etiti 4 na 4.5.
l-m-m3-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Ngosipụta ahụ na-aghọ 0 ebe uru ya na-agbanwe site na nke na-adịghị mma gaa na nke dị mma; ya mere ahọpụtara m n'etiti 4 na 4.5.

l-m-m3-b04-17.material: Ị chọrọ ịtụ uru y mgbe x=6.9 n'ime quadratic function y=x²/2 n'enweghị calculator. 6.9 dị nso na 7.
l-m-m3-b04-17.s.s1.prompt: Uru y bụ ihe dịka ole?

l-m-m3-b04-17.s.s1.explain: 6.9≈7, ya mere y≈7²/2=24.5. Uru n'ezie bụ ihe dịka 23.8, ya mere 24 ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ i gbanwee 6.9 ka ọ bụrụ 7, 7²/2=24.5, ihe dịka 24, ya mere 24 ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b04-23.title: Ịtụ ịdị elu slide 40°
l-m-m3-b04-23.goal: Tụọ ịdị elu elu slide, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b04-23.material: Slide dị ogologo 5 m na-eme angle 40° n'ala. sin 40°≈0.64, cos 40°≈0.77.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.prompt: Elu slide dị ihe dịka ole?
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ogologo kwụ ọtọ e nwetara site na ịmụba na cos 40°. Ịdị elu na-eji sin.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.c: Ị were hypotenuse dị ka ịdị elu.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ 5 e kewara na sin 40°. Ị ga-amụba.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s1.explain: Ịdị elu bụ hypotenuse×sin 40°≈5×0.64=3.2 m. Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa hypotenuse 5 m, ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s2.model.0: A na-achọta ịdị elu site n'ịmụba hypotenuse na sin 40°, ya bụ 5×0.64=3.2 m, ọ dịkwa mkpụmkpụ karịa hypotenuse 5 m, ya mere ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-23.s.s2.model.1: cos na-enye ogologo kwụ ọtọ, ịdị elu na-eji sin, ihe dịka 3.2 m.

l-m-m3-b04-37.s.s1.r.a: Deviation kacha elu bụ 4; ya mere 0.5 dịka nkezi pere mpe nke ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b04-37.s.s1.r.c: 8 bụ variance. Standard deviation bụ square root ya.
l-m-m3-b04-37.s.s1.r.d: 14 bụ mean, ọ bụghị mgbasasị uru.
l-m-m3-b04-37.s.s1.explain: Mean nke square deviations (variance) bụ 8; ya mere standard deviation bụ √8≈2.8, ihe dịka 3.
l-m-m3-b04-37.s.s2.model.0: Deviations sitere na −4 ruo 4, n’ozuzu ha dị ihe dịka 2 ruo 3; ya mere standard deviation bụ ihe dịka 3.

l-m-m3-b05-25.title: Ime atụmatụ ogologo onyinyo mgbe ịdị elu anyanwụ bụ 60°
l-m-m3-b05-25.goal: Kwuo atụmatụ ogologo onyinyo osisi dị mita 3 iji chọpụta ogologo kwesịrị ekwesị ma ọ bụ oke ya, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m3-b05-25.material: Ka anyị tụọ atụmatụ ogologo onyinyo osisi dị mita 3. Elu anyanwụ bụ 60°, tan 60°≈1.7. Ịdị elu osisi = onyinyo × tan 60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.prompt: Onyinyo ahụ ga-adị ihe dị ka ogologo ole?
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ uru 1.7÷3. E dozighị nkewa ahụ n’usoro kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ 3×1.7. Onyinyo = ịdị elu÷tan.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ewere ịdị elu na onyinyo ka ha nhata; ha na-adị nhata naanị mgbe akụkụ ahụ bụ 45°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Onyinyo = 3÷1.7≈1.76, ya bụ ihe dị ka mita 1.8. Ebe anyanwụ dị elu, onyinyo ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa osisi ahụ.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 3=onyinyo×1.7, onyinyo=3÷1.7≈1.8 m. Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa osisi ahụ, nke dabara na ịdị elu anyanwụ nke 60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Ebe tan 60° karịrị 1, onyinyo ahụ ga-adị mkpụmkpụ karịa ịdị elu osisi mita 3; 3÷1.7≈1.8 m dabara.

l-m-m3-b0s6-07.title: Ime atụmatụ mgbọrọgwụ dị mma nke x(x+3)=30
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.goal: Mee atụmatụ mgbọrọgwụ dị mma nke x(x+3)=30 iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.material: Ogige ifuru akụkụ anọ nke ogologo ya karịrị obosara ya site na 3 m nwere mpaghara 30 m². Ọ bụrụ na obosara bụ x m, x(x+3)=30. Mgbe x=4, ngosipụta ahụ bụ 28; mgbe x=5, ọ bụ 40.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.prompt: x dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ zuru ezu abụọ ndị dị aṅaa?
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe x=4, ọ bụ 28 ugbua, nke na-erughị 30. x ga-adị ukwuu karịa 4.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe x=5, ọ bụ 40 ugbua, nke karịrị 30. x pere mpe karịa 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na x=6, 6×9=54, nke karịrị 30 nke ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s1.explain: Uru ngosipụta ahụ bụ 28 mgbe x=4 na 40 mgbe x=5. 30 dị n'etiti ha, uru ahụ na-abawanye ka x na-abawanye, ya mere x dị n'etiti 4 na 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x=4, uru ya bụ 28, pere mpe karịa 30; mgbe x=5, ọ bụ 40, karịrị 30, ya mere x dị n'etiti 4 na 5.
l-m-m3-b0s6-07.s.s2.model.1: Ka x na-abawanye, x(x+3) na-abawanye kwa; 30 dị n'etiti 28 na 40, ya mere x dị n'etiti 4 na 5.

l-m-m3-b0s6-08.goal: Mee atụmatụ nha √10+√17 iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.material: E nwere ubi ifuru square nwere mpaghara 10 m² na 17 m². Anyị chọrọ ịtụ ogologo akụkụ ubi abụọ ahụ e debere n'usoro, site n'otu nsọtụ ruo na nke ọzọ. Mee atụmatụ n'enweghị igwe mgbako ma eriri 7 m ezuola.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.o.a: A pụghị ịmata: igwe mgbako dị mkpa
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.r.a: Naanị ị ga-achọ ịma 3² <10 na 4²<17 iji kpee ikpe site na ntule.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.r.b: Na-agbakọta na √10≈3 na √17≈4 na-enye 7, mana nchikota n'ezie ka ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.o.c: Ezughị ezu: nchikota nke ogologo abụọ ahụ karịrị 7
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.r.d: √10>3 na √17>4, yabụ nchikota enweghị ike ịbụ ihe na-erughị 7.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s1.explain: 3²=9<10, ya √10>3, na 4²=16<17, ya mere √17>4. Nchikota kariri 7, ya mere eriri ezughị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s2.model.0: √10>3 na √17>4, ya mere, nchikota karịrị 7. A 7 m eriri ezughị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-08.s.s2.model.1: Ebe ọ bụ na 9 <10 na 16 <17, ogologo abụọ ahụ dị ogologo karịa 3 na 4 n'otu n'otu, ya mere nchikota karịrị 7.

l-m-m3-b01-21.goal: Soro ngwọta (x−2)(x−3)=6 site na nzọụkwụ ruo na nzọụkwụ ka ịchọta ebe mbụ njehie mere, doziekwa ya.
l-m-m3-b01-21.material: Nzọpụta: ① (x−2)(x−3)=6 ② x−2=6 ma ọ bụ x−3=6 ③ x=8 ma ọ bụ x=9. Chọta nzọụkwụ mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.o.a: Ịga site na ① ruo ②
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.o.b: Ịga site na ② ruo ③
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na x−2=6, x=8; ọ bụrụ na x−3=6, x=9. Ngụkọta ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.r.c: ① depụtaghachiri nhatanha e nyere n'ajụjụ ahụ otu ọ dị, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na i tinye x=8, ị ga-enweta 6×5=30, nke na-abụghị 6.
l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Ị nwere ike ikwu na ihe na-amụba bụ 0 naanị mgbe ngwaahịa ahụ bụ 0. Mgbe ngwaahịa bụ 6, i nweghị ike ide ya otú a.

l-m-m3-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i tinye x=8, ị ga-enweta 6×5=30, ọ bụghị 6, ya mere ② apụtaghị otu ihe ahụ dịka ①. Mbụ mee ka akụkụ aka nri bụrụ 0.

l-m-m3-b01-22.title: Ịlele ime ka denominator nke 6/√3 ghọọ ọnụọgụ ezi uche
l-m-m3-b01-22.topic: Ime ka denominator ghọọ ọnụọgụ ezi uche
l-m-m3-b01-22.goal: Soro ngwọta ime ka denominator nke 6/√3 ghọọ ọnụọgụ ezi uche site na nzọụkwụ ruo na nzọụkwụ ka ịchọta ebe mbụ njehie mere, doziekwa ya.
l-m-m3-b01-22.material: Nzọpụta: ① 6/√3=(6×√3)/(√3×√3) ②=6√3/9 ③=2√3/3. Chọta nzọụkwụ mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.o.a: Ebe a mụbara numerator na denominator na √3 na ①
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.r.a: Ịmụba numerator na denominator n'otu ọnụọgụ anaghị agbanwe uru ahụ, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.o.b: Ebe e dere √3×√3 dịka 9 na ②
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.o.c: Ebe e mere ka irighiri ọnụọgụ dị mfe na ③
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.r.c: Ime ka 6√3/9 dị mfe site na ikekọrịta na 3 iji nweta 2√3/3 ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s1.r.d: 6/√3≈3.46, ma 2√3/3≈1.15, ya mere uru ha dị iche.
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s2.model.0: √3×√3 bụ 3, ma e dere ya dịka 9, nke gbanwere uru ahụ; ya mere ② ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na e mere ya nke ọma, 6√3/3=2√3.
l-m-m3-b01-22.s.s2.model.1: Ịbulite √3 n'ogo nke abụọ na-enye 3, ya mere denominator bụ 3, azịza ya bụ 2√3. 9 dị na ② bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-m3-b01-23.title: Ịlele itinye ihe ọnụ n'ime x²−x−12
l-m-m3-b01-23.topic: Itinye ihe ọnụ site n'iji nchikọta na ngwaahịa
l-m-m3-b01-23.goal: Soro ngwọta itinye ihe ọnụ n'ime x²−x−12 site na nzọụkwụ ruo na nzọụkwụ, chọta ebe mbụ njehie mere ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b01-23.material: Nzọpụta: ① Ụzọ ọnụọgụ ngwaahịa ha bụ −12 gụnyere (3, −4) na (−3, 4). ② Nchikọta bụ −1, ya mere họrọ (−3, 4). ③ x²−x−12=(x−3)(x+4). Kedu nzọụkwụ mbụ na-ezighị ezi?
l-m-m3-b01-23.s.s1.o.a: ① Ebe a chọtara ụzọ ọnụọgụ nwere ngwaahịa −12
l-m-m3-b01-23.s.s1.o.b: ③ Ebe e dere ụdị etinyere ihe ọnụ
l-m-m3-b01-23.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ụzọ ọnụọgụ a họọrọ ziri ezi, ụdị ahụ ga-abụkwa eziokwu. Nsogbu bụ ụzọ ọnụọgụ a họọrọ.

l-m-m3-b02-21.material: Ngwọta: ① Ebe y=x² na y=x+2 na-ezukọ, a na-achọta site na x²=x+2. ② x²−x−2=0, (x−2)(x+1)=0, ya mere x=2 ma ọ bụ x=−1. ③ Itinye n’ime y=x+2 na-enye (2, 4) na (−1, −1). Kedu usoro mbụ mejọrọ?
l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Ebe e mere ka expression abụọ ahụ hà
l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s1.r.a: N’ebe ha na-ezukọ, y bụ otu; ya mere x²=x+2 ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ebe a chọtara y mgbe x=−1
l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ x=−1, y=−1+2=1. Ebe ha na-ezukọ bụ (2, 4) na (−1, 1), nke kwekọrọ na y=x².
l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s2.model.0: Itinye x=−1 n’ime y=x+2 na-enye −1+2=1, mana e gbakọrọ ya dịka −1; ya mere ③ ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-21.s.s2.model.1: Ebe (−1)²=1, coordinate y agaghị abụ −1; ya mere ③ bụ ebe mbụ mejọrọ.

l-m-m3-b02-23.topic: Ịchọta akụkụ site na trigonometric ratio
l-m-m3-b02-23.goal: Soro ngwọta tan A mgbe sin A=5/13, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie pụtara.
l-m-m3-b02-23.material: Chọta tan A n’ime right triangle ebe sin A=5/13. Ngwọta: ① Tọọ ịdị elu 5 na hypotenuse 13. ② Ntọala=13−5=8. ③ tan A=5/8. Kedu usoro mbụ mejọrọ?
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.o.a: ① Ebe e debere ịdị elu na hypotenuse
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.r.a: sin A=ịdị elu÷hypotenuse; ya mere 5 na 13 ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.o.b: ② Ebe a chọtara ntọala dịka 13−5
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ebe e dere tan A dịka ịdị elu÷ntọala
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.r.c: tan A=ịdị elu÷ntọala bụ nkọwa ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ hypotenuse bụ 13, ntọala bụ 12, 5²+8² abụghị 13².
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s1.explain: Dịka Pythagorean theorem si dị, ntọala bụ √(13²−5²)=12, tan A=5/12.
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s2.model.0: Pythagorean theorem metụtara akụkụ atọ ahụ; ntọala abụghị 13−5 kama √(169−25)=12.
l-m-m3-b02-23.s.s2.model.1: 5²+8²=89 dị iche na 13²=169; ya mere 8 dị na ② ezighi ezi, tan A=5/12.

l-m-m3-b03-21.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na c=−1, −4ac=+4. Ya mere b²−4ac=16+4=20, x=−2±√5.

l-m-m3-b04-05.title: Ịlele ngwọta maka (2√3)²
l-m-m3-b04-05.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta gbakọrọ (2√3)², ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe ji eme, n'usoro; chọta ebe mbụ njehie mere ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b04-05.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta nke (2√3)². ① (2√3)²=2×(√3)² ②=2×3 ③=6. Lelee ahịrị nke ọ bụla ka ị mara ma azịza ikpeazụ ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: ② gbakọrọ ngosipụta dị na ① nke ọma. Ọ bụghị ebe njehie mere.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.c: ③ gbakọrọ ② nke ọma. Njehie ahụ dị naanị n'ahịrị bu ya ụzọ.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: (2√3)²=12, ma e dere 6, ya mere ihe adịghị mma.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Square nke ngwaahịa bụ ngwaahịa square nke ihe ọ bụla dị n'ime ya. (2√3)²=2²×(√3)²=4×3=12.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s2.model.0: Na ①, a ga-ebulikwa 2 n'ogo nke abụọ, ma e dere 2 dịka ọ dị. 2²=4, ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 4×3=12.
l-m-m3-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: Square nke ngwaahịa bụ ngwaahịa square nke ihe ọ bụla dị n'ime ya, ya mere ① kwesịrị ịbụ 2²×(√3)², azịza ya bụ 12.

l-m-m3-b04-13.title: Ịlele ngwọta e mere site n'imecha square
l-m-m3-b04-13.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta x²+6x−7=0, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe ji eme, n'usoro; chọta ebe mbụ njehie mere ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b04-13.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta x²+6x−7=0. ① x²+6x=7 ② x²+6x+9=7 ③ (x+3)²=7 ④ x=−3±√7. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bugharịrị −7 ma dee x²+6x=7 nke ọma.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: ③ chịkọtara akụkụ aka ekpe nke ② nke ọma. Akụkụ na-ezighị ezi bụ 7 dị n'ihu ya.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ ụdị ziri ezi sitere na ③. Njehie ahụ dị n'oge gara aga.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Na ②, a ga-agbakwunye 9 n'akụkụ abụọ. 7+9=16, ya mere (x+3)²=16, x=1 ma ọ bụ −7.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: A ga-agbakwunye 9 n'otu aka ahụ n'akụkụ abụọ, ma agbakwunyere ya naanị n'akụkụ aka ekpe. Akụkụ aka nri kwesịkwara ịghọ 16, ya mere ② bụ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrị ②, a gbakwụnyere 9 naanị n'otu akụkụ, nke mebiri nhatanha ahụ. Ya mere ọ ezighị ezi; ụdị e doziri bụ (x+3)²=16.

l-m-m3-b04-18.title: Ngwọta gụrụ ọdịdị y=−(x−1)²+4
l-m-m3-b04-18.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta gụrụ graph y=−(x−1)²+4, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ hiere ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b04-18.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta gụrụ y=−(x−1)²+4. ① Mgbe x=1, y=4 ② Coefficient x² bụ −1, ya mere ọ na-emeghe ala (convex downward) ③ Ya mere uru minimum bụ 4 na x=1. Kedu ahịrị mbụ hiere ụzọ?
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: Itinye x=1 nke ọma na-enye y=4.
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s1.r.c: ③ bụ nsonaazụ na-esochi ②. Akụkụ mbụ hiere ụzọ bụ ②.
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ coefficient bụ −1, ọ na-emeghe elu (convex upward), ya mere ② ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ coefficient bụ negative, ọ na-emeghe elu, ya mere uru maximum bụ 4 na x=1.
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ coefficient −1 bụ negative, ọ bụ convex upward, ya mere ② ezighị ezi. 4 bụ maximum, ọ bụghị minimum.
l-m-m3-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Ikwu convex downward na ② bụ mmejọ, ya mere ọ bụrụ i dozie ya ka convex upward, maximum bụ 4 na x=1.

l-m-m3-b04-27.title: Akụkụ nke ọzọ right triangle nwere hypotenuse 10
l-m-m3-b04-27.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta chọtara akụkụ nke ọzọ nke right triangle hypotenuse 10, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ hiere ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b04-27.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta chọtara akụkụ x ọzọ nke right triangle hypotenuse 10 na otu akụkụ 6. ① x²=10²+6² ② =136 ③ x=√136. Kedu ahịrị mbụ hiere ụzọ?
l-m-m3-b04-27.s.s1.r.c: √136 bụ uru si ②. Akụkụ mbụ hiere ụzọ bụ ①.
l-m-m3-b04-27.s.s1.r.d: E tinyere hypotenuse n'akụkụ a na-agbakwunye, ya mere ihe adịghị mma.
l-m-m3-b04-27.s.s1.explain: Square hypotenuse ga-adị n'akụkụ ngụkọta. x²+6²=10², ya mere x²=64, x=8.
l-m-m3-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Hypotenuse 10 ga-hà nhata ngụkọta squares nke akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ, ma na ① e tinyere ya n'akụkụ a na-agbakwunye. x²=100−36=64, x=8.
l-m-m3-b04-27.s.s2.model.1: Na Pythagorean theorem, akụkụ kacha ogologo dị n'akụkụ ngụkọta squares, ya mere ① ezighị ezi, edere ya nke ọma bụ x²+36=100.

l-m-m3-b04-34.title: Ịlele ngwọta ji diameter chọta akụkụ
l-m-m3-b04-34.goal: Soro ngwọta ji inscribed angle na diameter, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ mejọrọ.
l-m-m3-b04-34.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta ịchọta ∠BAC mgbe AB bụ diameter okirikiri na ∠ABC=35°. ① Ebe AB bụ diameter, ∠ACB=90°. ② ∠BAC=180°−35°=145°. ③ ∠BAC=145°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: Inscribed angle na diameter bụ 90°, ya mere ① ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.r.c: ③ sitere n’uru ②. Njehie mbụ bụ ②.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.r.d: Nke a ezighi ezi n’ihi na ewepụghị 90° na nchikọta akụkụ triangle.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta akụkụ ime triangle bụ 180°; ya mere ∠BAC=180°−90°−35°=55°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: Na ②, a ga-ewepụkwa ∠ACB=90°, mana e wepụrụ naanị 35°. Dozie ya: 180°−90°−35°=55°.
l-m-m3-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: Nchikọta akụkụ triangle atọ bụ 180°; ya mere ∠BAC=180°−90°−35°, ② bụ njehie mbụ.

l-m-m3-b05-05.title: Ịlele Ngwọta √12+√27
l-m-m3-b05-05.goal: Soro ngwọta na-eme √12+√27 ka ọ dị mfe, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, chọta ebe mbụ hiere ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-m3-b05-05.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta na-eme √12+√27 ka ọ dị mfe. ① √12=2√3 ② √27=9√3 ③ 2√3+9√3=11√3. Chọta ahịrị mbụ hiere ụzọ.
l-m-m3-b05-05.s.s1.r.c: ③ gbakwụnyere site na uru ②, ya mere ọ bụghị mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-m3-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: 27=9×3, ya mere √27=3√3, ma e dere 9√3, ya mere ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Ebe 27=9×3, √27 kwesịrị ịbụ 3√3, ma e dere 9√3. Mgbe e mere nke ọma, 2√3+3√3=5√3.
l-m-m3-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Square number 9 na-aghọ 3 mgbe ọ pụtara n'okpuru root sign, ya mere ② ezighị ezi, mgbe e doziri ngụkọta bụ 5√3.

l-m-m3-b05-14.goal: Soro ngwọta nke (x−1)(x−4)=10 site n’usoro, ma ọ bụ soro njikọ ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ.

l-m-m3-b05-20.title: Ịchọta a n’ime y=ax² site n’isi (2, 12)
l-m-m3-b05-20.goal: Soro ngwọta nke y=ax² nke na-agafe n’isi (2, 12) site n’usoro, ma ọ bụ soro njikọ ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ e hiere ụzọ.
l-m-m3-b05-20.material: Eserese y=ax² na-agafe n’isi (2, 12). Nke a bụ ngwọta iji chọta a. ① 12=a×2 ② a=6 ③ y=6x². Chọta ahịrị mbụ ezighi ezi.

l-m-m3-b05-20.s.s1.explain: Itinye x=2 na-enye 12=a×2²=4a. Ya mere a=3, y=3x².
l-m-m3-b05-20.s.s2.model.0: N’ime ①, e bulighị x=2 n’ọkwa abụọ. Ebe 12=a×2²=4a, dozie ya ka a=3.
