l-m-m3-b05-34.title: Ịlele ngwọta maka otu akụkụ nke akụkụ anọ e debanyere n’ime okirikiri
l-m-m3-b05-34.goal: Soro ngwọta banyere akụkụ abụọ na-eche ibe ha ihu nke akụkụ anọ e debanyere n’ime okirikiri site n’usoro, ma ọ bụ soro njikọ ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere ụzọ.
l-m-m3-b05-34.material: N’akụkụ anọ ABCD e debanyere n’ime okirikiri, ∠A=3x° na ∠C=2x°+20°. Nke a bụ ngwọta: ① Ha bụ akụkụ na-eche ibe ha ihu, ya mere 3x=2x+20 ② x=20 ③ ∠A=60°.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.b: ② doziri nhata sitere na ① nke ọma. Njehie ahụ dị na ①.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: ③ tinyere nsonaazụ ② n’ụzọ ziri ezi. Ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: 60° na 60° na-agbakọta bụrụ 120°, ọ bụghị 180°, ya mere ọ ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta akụkụ nkuku abụọ na-abụghị ibe ha bụ 180°. 3x+2x+20=180, ya mere x=32, ∠A=96°.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ nkuku na-abụghị ibe ha ahaghị nhata; nchikọta ha ga-abụrịrị 180°, ma ① mere ka ha hà nhata. 3x+2x+20=180, ya mere x=32.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ nkuku na-abụghị ibe ha nke quadrilateral dị n'okirikiri na-agbakọta bụrụ 180°, ya mere ① ezighị ezi, mgbe e doziri ya nke ọma ∠A=96°.

l-m-m3-b05-39.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta mgbanwe gbasasịrị data 3, 5, 7, 9. ① Nkezi=(3+5+7+9)/4=6 ② Ọdịiche bụ −3, −1, 1, 3 ③ Nchikọta square ọdịiche=9+1+1+9=18 ④ Mgbanwe gbasasịrị=18/4=4.5.

l-m-m3-b05-39.s.s1.r.b: Ọdịiche ndị a chọtara site n'iwepụ 6 na uru nke ọ bụla ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-39.s.s1.r.d: ④ kewara uru sitere na ③ nke ọma. Njehie mbụ bụ ③.
l-m-m3-b05-39.s.s2.model.0: 9+1+1+9 bụ 20, ma a gbakọtara ya n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi bụrụ 18, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi. Mgbe e mere ya nke ọma, mgbanwe gbasasịrị bụ 20/4=5.

l-m-m3-b0s6-09.goal: Soro usoro nke usoro nke x²−6x+9=0, ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya na mmetụta ya, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.material: Ngwọta: ahịrị mbụ (x−3)²=0. Ahịrị nke abụọ x-3=0 ma ọ bụ x+3=0. Ahịrị nke atọ x=3 ma ọ bụ x=-3. Chọta ahịrị mbụ ebe ngwọta a na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.o.a: Ebe a na-eji (x−3)² n'ahịrị nke mbụ
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.r.a: x²−6x+9 bụ (x−3)², ya mere nhazi ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.o.b: Ebe a na-eji x+3=0 n'ahịrị nke abụọ
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.o.c: Ebe e dere ihe ngwọta n'ahịrị nke atọ
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrị nke atọ na-esote ahịrị nke abụọ, yabụ na ọ bụghị mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na itinye x=-3, ị ga-enweta 9+18+9=36, nke na-abụghị 0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s1.explain: (x−3)²=0 bụ okwu ebe x-3 na-amụba ugboro abụọ. Ya mere enwere naanị x-3=0, na x=3 bụ naanị ihe ngwọta.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s2.model.0: (x−3)²=(x−3)(x−3), ya mere ihe abụọ a bụ x-3. x+3=0 esighị ebe ọ bụla abịa, yabụ ahịrị nke abụọ adịghị mma.
l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na itinye x=-3, ị ga-enweta 36, ​​yabụ na ọ bụghị ihe ngwọta. X+3=0 dị n'ahịrị nke abụọ ezighi ezi, na x=3 bụ naanị ngwọta.

l-m-m3-b0s6-10.title: Na-enyocha ihe ngwọta maka obosara nke ala
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ site na usoro ihe ngwọta, ma ọ bụ eriri nke ihe kpatara na mmetụta, maka nsogbu mpaghara nke ala nke obosara ya dị 2 m dị mkpụmkpụ, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.material: Otu ala nwere ogologo x m ​​na obosara 2 m dị mkpụmkpụ karịa ogologo ya, mpaghara ya dịkwa 15 m². 1) x (x−2)=15 2) x²−2x−15=0 3) (x−5)(x+3)=0 4) x=5 ma obu x=-3 5) Azịza: ogologo ya bụ 5 m ma ọ bụ -3 m. Ebee ka ndudue nke mbụ dị?
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo x, obosara x-2, mpaghara 15, ya mere x (x-2) = 15 ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.o.b: Ebe a na-ahazi nha nha na 2)
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.r.b: Ịkwaga 15 n'aka ekpe na-enye x²−2x−15=0, nke ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.o.c: Ebe a na-eme ihe nrụpụta na 3)
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.r.c: (x−5)(x+3)=x²−2x−15, ya mere ihe nrụpụta ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.o.d: Ebe a na-ekpebi azịza ya na 5)
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s1.explain: -3 m enweghị ike ịbụ ogologo. N'ime ihe ngwọta, naanị 5 m dabara na ọnọdụ nke nsogbu ahụ (ogologo> 0), ya mere ọ bụ azịza ya.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s2.model.0: Ogologo enweghị ike ịdị njọ, yabụ gụnyere -3 m na azịza na 5) ezighi ezi, azịza ya bụ 5 m.
l-m-m3-b0s6-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ x = -3, obosara na-aghọ -5 m, nke na-adabaghị na ọnọdụ ahụ. Na 5), ​​naanị 5 m ka ekwesịrị ka edere dịka azịza ya.

l-m-m3-b01-28.material: N'ime right triangle, tan A=3/4. Were ịdị elu 3, base 4, chọta hypotenuse, mesịa gosipụta otu angle A dịka sin A.

l-m-m3-b01-28.s.s1.r.b: 4/5 bụ cos A, ya bụ base÷hypotenuse.
l-m-m3-b01-28.s.s1.r.c: 3/4 bụ tan A, ya bụ ịdị elu÷base.
l-m-m3-b01-28.s.s1.explain: Hypotenuse bụ √(3²+4²)=5, ya mere sin A=3/5.
l-m-m3-b01-28.s.s2.model.0: Hypotenuse bụ √(9+16)=5, sin A bụ ịdị elu÷hypotenuse, ya mere 3/5.

l-m-m3-b02-27.title: Ịgbanwe ọdịdị L ka ọ bụrụ rectangle
l-m-m3-b02-27.goal: Gbanwee a²−b² gaa n’ụdị ọzọ, kọwakwa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-27.material: Bee obere square akụkụ ya bụ b n’otu akụkụ nke square akụkụ ya bụ a. Mpaghara ọdịdị L fọdụrụ bụ a²−b². Bee ọdịdị L ahụ ma jikọta iberibe ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ rectangle.
l-m-m3-b02-27.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ogologo na obosara rectangle nwere otu mpaghara ahụ?
l-m-m3-b02-27.s.s1.r.a: Mpaghara ga-abụ ab, nke dị iche na a²−b².
l-m-m3-b02-27.s.s1.explain: a²−b²=(a+b)(a−b). Bee ma jikọta ọdịdị L ka rectangle ogologo ya bụrụ a+b, obosara a−b.
l-m-m3-b02-27.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe i bechara ma jikọta ọdịdị L, ọ na-aghọ rectangle ogologo a+b na obosara a−b; mpaghara bụ a²−b²=(a+b)(a−b).
l-m-m3-b02-27.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbasa (a+b)(a−b) na-enye a²−b²; ya mere mpaghara abụọ ahụ hà nhata.

l-m-m3-b02-28.title: Mgbe central angle karịrị inscribed angle site na 40°
l-m-m3-b02-28.topic: Nhatanha maka akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri na akụkụ etiti
l-m-m3-b02-28.goal: Degharịa ọnọdụ na akụkụ etiti karịrị akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri site na 40° ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b02-28.material: Maka otu arc, akụkụ etiti karịrị akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri site na 40°. Kwe ka nha akụkụ nkuku ahụ bụrụ x°, dee ọnọdụ a dịka nhatanha. Akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri bụ ọkara akụkụ etiti.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ nhatanha na-ekwu na akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri x dị 40° karịa akụkụ etiti 2x.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara na nchikọta akụkụ etiti na akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime ya bụ 40°.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s1.r.d: Akụkụ etiti abụghị ọkara akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri; ọ bụ okpukpu 2.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ etiti bụ 2x°, ọ karịrị akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri site na 40°, ya mere 2x=x+40. x=40.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ etiti bụ 2x°, ya bụ okpukpu 2 nke akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri x, ọ karịrịkwa x site na 40°, ya mere 2x=x+40.
l-m-m3-b02-28.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-aghọ 2x−x=40, ya mere x=40. Ọ bụ otu nhatanha ahụ; akụkụ nkuku e dere n'ime okirikiri bụ 40°, akụkụ etiti bụ 80°.

l-m-m3-b03-27.material: A tụbara bọọlụ elu. Ịdị elu ya mgbe nkeji t gachara bụ −5t²+20t m. Gbanwee nhatanha na-achọta oge ịdị elu bụ 15 m ka ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu t² bụrụ 1.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhatanha pụtara otu ihe ahụ?
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s1.r.a: Ikekọrịta akụkụ abụọ ahụ na −5 na-eme ka okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe bụrụ +3, ọ bụghị −3.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s1.r.b: Akara okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe dị iche. Ọ kwesịrị ịbụ 5t²−20t+15=0.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s1.r.c: 20t e kewara na −5 bụ −4t. Ịhapụrụ akara ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s1.explain: Site na −5t²+20t=15, ị ga-enweta −5t²+20t−15=0. Ikekọrịta akụkụ abụọ ahụ na −5 na-enye t²−4t+3=0.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s2.model.0: Ikekọrịta akụkụ abụọ nke −5t²+20t−15=0 na −5 na-enye t²−4t+3=0, ya mere ha pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-27.s.s2.model.1: Itinye t=1 na-enye −5+20=15, t²−4t+3 na-aghọkwa 0, ya mere ha nwere otu ngwọta.

l-m-m3-b03-28.title: Iji okwu kọwaa usoro mgbanwe gbasasịrị
l-m-m3-b03-28.goal: Gbanwee usoro ịchọta mgbanwe gbasasịrị ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-28.material: A na-achọta mgbanwe gbasasịrị dịka (nchikọta square ọdịiche)÷(ọnụọgụ uru). Ị chọrọ iji okwu kọwaa usoro a.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta dị aṅaa pụtara otu ihe ahụ dịka usoro ahụ?
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.o.a: Nkezi nke ọdịiche uru ọ bụla na nkezi, mgbe e buliri ọdịiche ahụ n'ogo nke abụọ
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.o.b: Nkezi nke square nke uru ọ bụla
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.r.b: Ị buliri uru ndị ahụ n'onwe ha n'ogo nke abụọ, ọ bụghị ọdịiche ha.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.o.c: Nchikọta ọdịiche niile e kewara na ọnụọgụ uru
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.r.c: Nchikọta ọdịiche na-abụ 0 mgbe niile, ya mere enweghị ike iwepụ ibuli ha n'ogo nke abụọ.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.o.d: Uru kacha ukwuu e wepụrụ na nke kacha nta
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ oke. Ọ bụghị mgbanwe gbasasịrị.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s1.explain: Ịbulite ọdịiche (iche n'etiti uru na nkezi) n'ogo nke abụọ, ịgbakọta ha niile, ikekọrịta na ọnụọgụ uru na-enye mgbanwe gbasasịrị.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s2.model.0: Ịbulite ọdịiche n'ogo nke abụọ, ịgbakọta ha, ikekọrịta na ọnụọgụ uru bụ mgbanwe gbasasịrị; ya mere ị nwere ike ịkpọ ya nkezi square ọdịiche.
l-m-m3-b03-28.s.s2.model.1: Mgbanwe gbasasịrị na-ebuli ebe uru ọ bụla dị site na nkezi n'ogo nke abụọ ma chọta nkezi ya, ya mere ọ na-egosi etu uru si gbasasịa.

l-m-m3-b03-29.title: Iji anya kọwaa chord abụọ nwere otu ogologo
l-m-m3-b03-29.goal: Gbanwee chord abụọ nwere otu ogologo n'ime otu okirikiri ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-29.material: Kwuo na chord AB na CD nke otu okirikiri nwere otu ogologo. Kọwaa eziokwu a site n'iji anya dị n'etiti etiti okirikiri O na chord abụọ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.o.a: Chord dị anya karịa na etiti O dị ogologo karịa
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.r.a: Ka chord na-adị anya n'etiti, ka ọ na-adị mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.o.b: Chord abụọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ n'otu ibe ha
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.r.b: Ha nwere ike ghara ịdị n'otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ ọbụlagodi ma ogologo ha hà nhata.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.o.c: Chord abụọ ahụ na-ezute n'otu isi
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.r.c: Ha nwere ike ghara izute ọbụlagodi ma ogologo ha hà nhata.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.o.d: Chord abụọ ahụ dị otu anya site n'etiti O
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s1.explain: N'ime otu okirikiri, chord ndị dị otu anya site n'etiti nwere otu ogologo; ọ bụrụ na ogologo ha hà nhata, anya ha dịkwa otu.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na anya site n'etiti ruo chord hà nhata, akụkụ triangle akụkụ aka nri hà nhata, ya mere ọkara chord nke ọ bụla hà nhata, chord abụọ ahụ nwekwara otu ogologo.
l-m-m3-b03-29.s.s2.model.1: Ka chord na-adị anya n'etiti, ka ọ na-adị mkpụmkpụ; ya mere ma ogologo ha hà nhata, anya ha site n'etiti ga-abụrịrị otu.

l-m-m3-b03-30.title: Iji ogologo eriri na akụkụ nkuku kọwaa ịdị elu egbe ikuku
l-m-m3-b03-30.goal: Gbanwee ịdị elu egbe ikuku ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b03-30.material: Eriri egbe ikuku ogologo L agbatịla nke ọma ma mee akụkụ nkuku θ na ala. Kwe ka ịdị elu egbe ikuku bụrụ h, dee h site n'iji L na oke trigonometrị.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s1.r.b: tan θ bụ ịdị elu÷ogologo kwụ ọtọ, ya mere o nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ogologo eriri.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s1.r.c: cos θ bụ ogologo dị n'ala e kewara na ogologo eriri.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s1.r.d: Ikekọrịta ga-eme ka ịdị elu karịa ogologo eriri, nke na-enweghị isi.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s1.explain: sin θ=ịdị elu÷ogologo eriri, ya mere h=L×sin θ.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s2.model.0: sin θ bụ ịdị elu e kewara na ogologo eriri, nke bụ hypotenuse, ya mere ịmụba akụkụ abụọ ahụ na L na-enye h=L×sin θ.
l-m-m3-b03-30.s.s2.model.1: Eriri bụ hypotenuse, ịdị elu bụ akụkụ dị n'ihu, ya mere jiri sin θ, nke bụ akụkụ dị n'ihu÷hypotenuse, nweta h=L×sin θ.

l-m-m3-b04-07.title: Ịgbanwe ngosipụta mpaghara ka ọ bụrụ ogologo×obosara
l-m-m3-b04-07.goal: Gbanwee ngosipụta mpaghara rectangle x²+5x+6 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b04-07.material: Mpaghara rectangle bụ x²+5x+6. Ị chọrọ idegharị mpaghara a dịka ngwaahịa (ogologo)×(obosara).
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s1.prompt: Rectangle dị aṅaa pụtara otu ihe ahụ dịka ngosipụta mpaghara ahụ?
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ x²+11x+30. Okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe abụghị 6.
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s1.r.d: Ngwaahịa ahụ bụ x²+7x+6. Ọnụọgụ dị n'ihu x dị iche.
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s1.explain: (x+2)(x+3)=x²+5x+6. Ị chọtara ọnụọgụ abụọ 2 na 3 ndị nchikọta ha bụ 5, ngwaahịa ha bụ 6.
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbasa (x+2)(x+3) na-enye x²+5x+6, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ dịka ngosipụta mpaghara mbụ.
l-m-m3-b04-07.s.s2.model.1: 2+3=5, 2×3=6, ya mere enwere ike idegharị x²+5x+6 dịka (x+2)(x+3).

l-m-m3-b04-19.material: Ị chọrọ ịgbanwe expression ka ọ bụrụ product form ka ị gụọ ozugbo isi ebe graph y=x²−4x+3 zutere x-axis.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu expression gbanwere na-eme ka a hụ x-intercepts ozugbo?
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: Ịgbasa na-enye x²+4x+3, nke dị iche.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s1.r.b: Ịgbasa na-enye x²+2x−3, nke dị iche.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Ịgbasa na-enye x²−6x+9, nke dị iche.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s1.explain: (x−1)(x−3)=x²−4x+3, uru x na-eme y=0 bụ 1 na 3.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Ịgbasa na-enye (x−1)(x−3)=x²−4x+3, otu ihe, x=1 na 3 ebe product bụ 0 na-egosi ozugbo, ya mere ọ dị mma.
l-m-m3-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: E nwere −1 na −3 nwere ngụkọta −4, ngwaahịa 3, ya mere ọ bụ (x−1)(x−3), x-intercepts bụ 1 na 3.

l-m-m3-b04-25.material: Ramp na-arị elu 3 m ka ọ na-aga 4 m kwụ ọtọ. Ka A bụrụ angle ramp na-eme na ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, gbanwee slope a ka ọ bụrụ asụsụ trigonometric ratios.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-egosi slope a nke ọma?
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s1.r.b: sin A bụ ịdị elu÷hypotenuse, ya bụ 3/5.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s1.r.c: cos A bụ base÷hypotenuse, ya bụ 4/5.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ uru e nwetara site n'ikewa ịdị elu na base n'usoro na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s1.explain: tan A=ịdị elu/base=3/4. Hypotenuse bụ 5, ya mere sin A=3/5, cos A=4/5.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s2.model.0: Ịdị elu e kewara na anya kwụ ọtọ bụ tan A, ya mere 3/4 nwere ike igosi dịka tan A.
l-m-m3-b04-25.s.s2.model.1: Otu slope si dị steep bụ ratio ịdị elu na base, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na tan A=3/4.

l-m-m3-b04-38.material: Na scatter plot, isi gbasasịrị mana ha na-aga site n’ala aka ekpe ruo elu aka nri. x bụ oge ọmụmụ, y bụ akara ule. Kọwaa ọdịdị a n’okwu.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọdịdị scatter plot nke ọma?
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.o.a: Ka oge ọmụmụ na-adị ogologo, akara na-adị elu n’ozuzu.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.o.b: Oge ọmụmụ na akara enweghị mmekọrịta.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.r.b: Isi ahụ gbakọtara n’otu ntụziaka; ya mere mmekọrịta dị.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.o.c: Ka oge ọmụmụ na-adị ogologo, akara na-ebelata n’ozuzu.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.r.c: Isi na-aga n’elu aka nri, ọ bụghị n’ala aka nri.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.o.d: Ka oge ọmụmụ na-adị ogologo, akara ga-adị elu n’ezie.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.r.d: Isi gbasasịrị, ya mere ị gaghị ekwu “n’ezie”.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s1.explain: Isi na-aga n’elu aka nri, ya mere correlation dị mma; mana ha gbasasịrị, ya mere ọ bụghị n’ezie, naanị n’ozuzu.
l-m-m3-b04-38.s.s2.model.0: Isi na-aga n’elu aka nri; nke a pụtara na ka oge ọmụmụ na-adị ogologo, akara na-adị elu n’ozuzu. Ha gbasasịrị, ya mere ọ bụghị n’ezie.

l-m-m3-b05-07.s.s2.model.1: Ngwaahịa sum na difference na-aghọ difference of squares, ya mere enwere ike ide 99×101 ka 100²−1².

l-m-m3-b0s6-11.title: √2 n'aka ekpe nke 1 n'ahịrị nọmba
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.goal: Tụgharịa ọnọdụ nke isi ihe n'ahịrị nọmba, nke edere n'okwu, gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (nkwupụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.material: Point P na ahịrị ọnụọgụ dị √2 site na 1 gaa n'aka ekpe. (√2 bụ ihe dịka 1.41.) Dee nhazi nke isi P dị ka nọmba.
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ ezigbo nhazi nke isi P?
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s1.r.b: √2−1≈0.41 dị mma, yabụ na ọ bụ akara aka nri nke 0. P dị n'aka ekpe nke 0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s1.r.c: -√2 bụ √2 n'aka ekpe nke 0. Ebe mmalite abụghị 1.
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s1.explain: Ịga aka ekpe pụtara ibelata. √2 n'aka ekpe nke 1 bụ 1−√2 (ihe dịka -0.41).
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s2.model.0: Ịga √2 n'aka ekpe pụtara ịwepụ √2 na 1, ya mere nhazi ahụ bụ 1−√2 (ihe dịka -0.41), nke bụ otu ọnọdụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-11.s.s2.model.1: 1-√2≈1−1.41=-0.41, nke bụ otu ọnọdụ dị ka isi 1.41 n'aka ekpe nke 1, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.

l-m-m3-b0s6-12.topic: Ihe ngwọta nke nhatantị anọ pụtara
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.goal: Tụgharịa tebụl ụkpụrụ nke x²−3x−4 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (nkwupụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe kpatara o jiri pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.material: Edere ụkpụrụ nke x²−3x−4 na tebụl. x=-2→6, -1→0, 0→-4, 1→-6, 2→-6, 3→-4, 4→0, 5→6. Tụgharịa tebụl a ka ọ bụrụ nkwupụta gbasara nhata x²−3x−4=0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-atụgharị tebụl n'ụzọ ziri ezi ka ọ bụrụ ihe ngwọta nke nhata x²−3x−4=0?

l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s1.r.b: Na x = 0 uru okwu a bụ -4, na x = 5 ọ bụ 6, ya mere, ọ bụghịkwa 0.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s1.r.c: -4 bụ uru nke okwu na x=0 na 3. Ọ bụghị ngwọta.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s1.explain: Ihe ngwọta bụ x nke na-eme ka uru nke okwu 0. Na tebụl, ebe ọnụ ahịa 0 bụ x = -1 na x = 4.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s2.model.0: Ihe ngwọta nke nhata bụ x nke na-eme ka uru nke okwu 0, ya mere x = -1 na 4, ebe tebụl na-egosi uru 0, bụ ngwọta.
l-m-m3-b0s6-12.s.s2.model.1: Ịtinye na x = -1 na 4 na-eme ka uru 0, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ, na ụkpụrụ ndị ọzọ nke x adịghị eme uru 0, ya mere ha abụghị ngwọta.

l-m-m3-b01-32.material: Gap mere denominator 6/√2 rational wee dee 3√2. Eul jiri √2≈1.41, gbakọọ 6÷1.41, dee ihe dịka 4.26. Nke a bụ ọnọdụ achọrọ uru exact.

l-m-m3-b02-31.s.s1.o.b: Onye A: Uru kacha nta bụ nhazi y nke vertex, 1

l-m-m3-b04-24.material: N'ime right triangle hypotenuse 8, otu angle bụ 30°. A chọtara ogologo akụkụ na-emegide 30° dịka A: 8×sin 30°, B: 8×cos 30°.

l-m-m3-b05-08.material: E mere factoring 2x²−8. A: 2(x−2)(x+2). B: (x−2)(2x+4). Ha abụọ na-agbasa ka 2x²−8. Chọta nke e mere ruo mgbe enweghị ihe ọzọ a ga-ekewa.

l-m-m3-b05-08.s.s1.o.b: B naanị ka e mere kpamkpam
l-m-m3-b05-08.s.s1.r.b: 2x+4 nke B nwere ike ime factoring ọzọ dịka 2(x+2).
l-m-m3-b05-08.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ ka e mere kpamkpam
l-m-m3-b05-08.s.s1.r.c: 2x+4 nke B nwere ike ime factoring ọzọ site na common factor 2.
l-m-m3-b05-08.s.s1.r.d: Ha abụọ na-agbasa ka 2x²−8, ya mere nke ọ bụla ezighị ezi.

l-m-m3-b05-16.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ, ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ, e si chọta uru kacha nta nke y=x²−6x+5. Họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b05-16.material: Chọtara uru kacha nta nke y=x²−6x+5 n’ụzọ abụọ. A: tinye x=3, axis nke symmetry, iji nweta 9−18+5=−4. B: y=0 n’ebe ọ na-agafe x-axis, x=1 na 5, ya mere uru kacha nta bụ 0.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ chọtara uru kacha nta nke ọma?
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe x=3, y=−4, nke dị ala karịa 0; ya mere 0 abụghị uru kacha nta.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s1.r.c: Uru ndị ahụ dị iche, −4 na 0, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s1.r.d: Uru −4 nke A bụ nke ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s1.explain: Uru kacha nta dị n’isi ntụgharị. N’isi ahụ x=3, y=−4; uru y=0 n’ebe eserese na-agafe x-axis abụghị nke kacha nta.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe x=3, y=−4, nke dị ala karịa 0; ya mere 0 n’ebe eserese na-agafe x-axis enweghị ike ịbụ nke kacha nta, A ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-16.s.s2.model.1: Eserese ahụ na-ehulata elu, isi ntụgharị ya dịkwa n’axis nke symmetry; ya mere −4 mgbe x=3 bụ uru kacha nta.

l-m-m3-b05-21.title: Olee otú sin na cos si agbanwe ka akụkụ ahụ na-ebuwanye ibu?
l-m-m3-b05-21.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ, ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ, gbasara mgbanwe sin A na cos A site na 0° ruo 90°. Họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b05-21.material: Tụnyere mgbanwe ka akụkụ A na-ebuwanye ibu site na 0° ruo 90°. A: sin A na-ebuwanye ibu, cos A na-ebelata. B: ma sin A ma cos A na-ebuwanye ibu.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke kọwara ya nke ọma?
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s1.r.b: Site na cos 0°=1 ruo cos 90°=0, ọ na-ebelata n’ezie.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s1.r.c: “Cos A na-ebuwanye ibu kwa” nke B ezighị ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s1.r.d: A ziri ezi. sin 30°=0.5 dị ala karịa sin 60°≈0.87.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s1.explain: Ka A na-ebuwanye ibu site na 0° ruo 90°, sin A na-arị elu site na 0 ruo 1, cos A na-agbada site na 1 ruo 0.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s2.model.0: sin 30°=0.5 na-arị elu ruo sin 60°≈0.87; cos 30°≈0.87 na-agbada ruo cos 60°=0.5. Ya mere A ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b05-21.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe akụkụ ahụ na-ebuwanye ibu, ịdị elu na-abawanye, ntọala na-ebelata; ya mere sin na-abawanye, cos na-ebelata.

l-m-m3-b0s6-13.title: (a-b)² na (b-a)² hà bụ otu?
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.goal: Tulee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta gbasara mmekọrịta dị n'etiti (a-b)² na (b-a)², họrọ nke dabara adaba, wee kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.material: Jian: (a-b)² na (b−a)² bụ ọnụọgụgụ dị iche naanị na akara. Doha: Mba, ha abụọ na-abụ otu mgbe niile. Gbakọọ okwu abụọ a maka a=5, b=2 wee kpebie onye ziri ezi.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.o.a: Doha: Okwu abụọ a na-abụ otu mgbe niile
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.o.b: Jian: Okwu abụọ a dị iche naanị na akara
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.r.b: (a-b)²=9 na (b-a)²=9, ya mere ihe iriba ama ndị ahụ bụ otu. Otu square anaghị adị njọ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.r.c: Ha bụ okwu ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha, yabụ na ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.o.d: Ọ dabere na ụkpụrụ nke a na b
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe agbasawanye, ha abụọ bụ a²−2ab+b², yabụ na ha bụ otu n'agbanyeghị ụkpụrụ.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s1.explain: b-a=-(a-b), na (-m)²=m². Ya mere (a-b)²=(b-a)² na-ejide mgbe niile.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s2.model.0: b-a bụ a-b ji -1 amụba, na squaring na-ewepụ akara ahụ, ya mere (a-b)²=(b-a)². Maka 5 na 2, ha abụọ bụkwa 9.
l-m-m3-b0s6-13.s.s2.model.1: Maka a=5, b=2, 3²=9 na (-3)²=9 bụ otu, ma mgbe agbasawanye ha abụọ bụ a²−2ab+b², yabụ Doha ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b0s6-14.title: Ụzọ abụọ iji gosi √6×√24=12
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ maka ịchọta uru nke √6×√24, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.material: Seoa dere √6×√24=√144=12. Raon mụbara √6≈2.449 na √24≈4.899 iji nweta ihe dịka 11.998, ma kwuo na ọ bụ 12. Kpebie usoro nke dabara adaba maka igosi na ọ bụ kpọmkwem 12.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu usoro kachasị mma maka igosi "kpọmkwem 12"?
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.o.b: Raon: mụbaa dị ka decimal iji nweta ihe dịka iri na abụọ
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaahịa nke approximation bụ naanị nso 12. Ọ nweghị ike igosi na ọ bụ kpọmkwem 12.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.r.c: Mkpebi nwere njehie, yabụ na ha enweghị ike igosi "kpọmkwem".
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.r.d: Iji √a ×√b=√(ab), ị nwere ike ịchọta uru ọ bara.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s1.explain: √a×√b=√(ab) na 144=12², ya mere, ọ bụ kpọmkwem 12. Ihe iribare ngwaahịa bụ naanị nso 12, dị ka 11.998.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s2.model.0: √6×√24=√144 na 12²=144, n'ihi ya, ọ bụ kpọmkwem 12. The decimal ngwaahịa bụ 11.998, nke dịtụ iche na 12.
l-m-m3-b0s6-14.s.s2.model.1: Iji nso nso a na-emepụta njehie, yabụ ị nwere ike ịmara na ọ bụ ihe dịka 12, mana ijikọta mgbọrọgwụ na-enye √144=12, nke dabara nke ọma.

l-m-m3-b01-36.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi ọnụahịa achịcha, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b01-36.material: Otu ogbe achịcha na-efu 1000 won, a na-erekwa 100 kwa ụbọchị. Oge ọ bụla ọnụahịa mụbara site na 100 won, ire kwa ụbọchị na-ebelata site na 5. Anyị chọrọ nnukwu uru na ka ire kwa ụbọchị ghara ịdị ala karịa 90.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s1.prompt: Ọnụahịa dị aṅaa na-enye uru kacha ukwuu ma na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ?
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.b: Uru ya kacha ukwuu, ma ire bụ 75, nke na-emebi ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.c: Uru ya dị elu, ma ire bụ 80, nke na-emebi ọnọdụ 90.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma uru ya pere mpe karịa nke 1200 won.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọnụahịa bụ 1200 won, a na-ere 90, ya mere uru bụ 108000 won. Ọ kacha elu n'ime ọnụahịa ndị na-emezu ọnọdụ 90.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe ọnụahịa bụ 1200 won, a na-ere 90, nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, uru ya bụ 108000 won, karịa 100000 won nke ọnụahịa 1000 won.
l-m-m3-b01-36.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụahịa 1400 won na 1500 won na-enye uru ka ukwuu, ma ire erughị 90, ya mere 1200 won dabara adaba.

l-m-m3-b01-37.title: Ịhọrọ n'etiti nkezi na ịdị n'otu
l-m-m3-b01-37.topic: Ịhọrọ site na nkezi na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ
l-m-m3-b01-37.goal: Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ onye egwuregwu site n'ileba anya n'ọnụọgụ nkezi na otu akara ya si dị n'otu, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b01-37.material: Ndị a bụ akara ndị egwuregwu anọ. A nwere nkezi 80 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 3, B nwere nkezi 82 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10, C nwere nkezi 78 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 2, D nwere nkezi 85 na ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 12. Họrọ onye nkezi ya dị opekata mpe 80, akara ya dịkwa n'otu karịa.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s1.prompt: Kedu onye egwuregwu kacha emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ?
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s1.r.a: Ndapụ ọkọlọtọ ya kacha nta, ma nkezi 78 erughị 80.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi ya dị opekata mpe 80, ma ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 10 pụtara na akara ya na-agbanwe karịa nke A.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s1.r.c: Nkezi ya kacha elu, ma ndapụ ọkọlọtọ 12 pụtara na akara ya na-agbanwe nke ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s1.explain: N'ime A, B na D ndị nkezi ha dị opekata mpe 80, A nwere ndapụ ọkọlọtọ kacha nta, ya mere A dabara adaba.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s2.model.0: Ndị egwuregwu nkezi ha dị opekata mpe 80 bụ A, B na D; n'ime ha A nwere ndapụ ọkọlọtọ kacha nta ma akara ya dị n'otu karịa, ya mere A dabara adaba.
l-m-m3-b01-37.s.s2.model.1: C nwere akara kacha n'otu, ma nkezi ya erughị 80, ya mere ọ na-emebi ọnọdụ ahụ, A bụkwa nke kacha dabara adaba.

l-m-m3-b01-38.title: Ogige ifuru kacha ukwuu nwere otu okirikiri
l-m-m3-b01-38.goal: Mgbe ị na-eme ogige ifuru kacha ukwuu nke na-emezu ọnọdụ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b01-38.material: Anyị na-eme ogige ifuru akụkụ anọ nwere okirikiri 20m. Ogologo na obosara ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nke mita; ka ọ maa mma, ogologo ga-adịkarịa ala 2m karịa obosara. Anyị chọrọ ka mpaghara ya buru ibu kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s1.prompt: Atụmatụ dị aṅaa na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ ma nwee mpaghara kacha ukwuu?
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma mpaghara 16㎡ ya dị obere karịa.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s1.r.b: Mpaghara ya kacha ukwuu na 25㎡, ma ogologo adịghị karịa obosara.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma mpaghara 21㎡ ya pere mpe karịa 6×4=24㎡.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ogologo+obosara=10 ma ọdịiche ha dị opekata mpe 2, 6×4=24㎡ bụ mpaghara kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s2.model.0: Ogologo+obosara=10, ogologo ga-adịkwa opekata mpe 2m karịa, ya mere 6×4=24㎡ bụ nke kacha ukwuu n'ime atụmatụ ndị na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-38.s.s2.model.1: 5×5 bụ square, ya mere ọ na-emebi ọnọdụ ahụ; 7×3 na 8×2 nwere mpaghara 21㎡ na 16㎡, pere mpe karịa 24㎡, ya mere 6×4 dabara adaba.

l-m-m3-b01-39.title: Ịhọrọ akụkụ a ga-eji tinye ubube
l-m-m3-b01-39.goal: Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ akụkụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ịdị elu na anya, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b01-39.material: Ubube 5m dabeere na mgbidi. Ịdị elu ọ ruru (5×sin θ) ga-abụ opekata mpe 4.6m, anya dị n'etiti ụkwụ ya na mgbidi (5×cos θ) ga-abụ opekata mpe 1.5m. sin 65°≈0.91, sin 70°≈0.94, cos 70°≈0.34, cos 75°≈0.26.
l-m-m3-b01-39.s.s1.prompt: Akụkụ θ dị aṅaa na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ?
l-m-m3-b01-39.s.s1.r.c: Anya dị n'etiti ụkwụ ubube na mgbidi bụ 5×0.26=1.3m, nke erughị 1.5m.
l-m-m3-b01-39.s.s1.explain: Mgbe akụkụ bụ 70°, ịdị elu bụ 5×0.94=4.7m, anya bụ 5×0.34=1.7m, ya mere ha abụọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-39.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe akụkụ bụ 70°, ịdị elu bụ 4.7m, opekata mpe 4.6m, anya bụkwa 1.7m, opekata mpe 1.5m, ya mere ha abụọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-m3-b01-39.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ nta na-eme ka ịdị elu dị mkpụmkpụ, nnukwu akụkụ na-eme ka anya dị mkpụmkpụ; ya mere 70° nke dị n'etiti ha dabara adaba.

l-m-m3-b02-36.title: Ịhọrọ ibu kacha ukwuu nke nwere ike ịgafe n'ọwara
l-m-m3-b02-36.goal: Tulee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha iji kpebie nha ibu ga-agafe n'ọwara, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b02-36.material: Akụkụ obe nke ọwara bụ y=−x²+6x (0≤x≤6, nkeji: m). Ụgbọala na-agafe kpọmkwem n'etiti ọwara (x=3). Ibu ahụ agaghị emetụ ọwara, mpaghara obosara×ịdị elu ya kwesịkwara ibu.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.prompt: N'ime ibu ndị nwere ike ịgafe n'ọwara, kedu nke nwere mpaghara obe kacha ukwuu?
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere ike ịgafe, ma mpaghara obe 16 ㎡ ya pere mpe karịa 20 ㎡.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe x=1, ịdị elu ọwara bụ 5 m, ya mere ịdị elu 6 m ga-emetụ ya.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe x=0.5, ịdị elu ọwara bụ 2.75 m, ya mere ịdị elu 4 m ga-emetụ ya.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s1.explain: Obosara 4 m na-ekpuchi x site na 1 ruo 5, ịdị elu n'akụkụ nsọtụ bụ y(1)=5. Ọ na-agafe ma ịdị elu ya ruru 5 m, mpaghara obe ya bụ 20 ㎡.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe obosara bụ 4 m, ịdị elu ọwara n'akụkụ x=1 bụ 5 m, ya mere ibu ruo 5 m n'ịdị elu nwere ike ịgafe, mpaghara obe 20 ㎡ bụkwa nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b02-36.s.s2.model.1: Obosara 4 m na ịdị elu 6 m ga-emetụ nsọtụ, obosara 5 m na-eme ka ịdị elu a kwadoro dị ala; ya mere obosara 4 m na ịdị elu 5 m bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b02-37.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi ya bụ 80, ma o nwere 45, nke na-emebi ọnọdụ akara 50.

l-m-m3-b02-38.s.s1.explain: Mgbe obosara bụ 2 cm, 24×34=816 cm², nke bụ 900 ma ọ bụ obere; mgbe ọ bụ 3 cm, ọ bụ 936 cm², nke karịrị.

l-m-m3-b02-38.s.s2.model.1: Ka border na-ebawanye obosara, ka mpaghara niile na-abawanye, ya mere họrọ 2 cm, obosara kasị ukwuu nke na-agaghị agafe 900 cm².

l-m-m3-b02-39.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka ramp dị nro ma ọ bụghị ogologo nke ukwuu, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b02-39.material: Ị na-ewu ramp na-arị elu 1.2 m. Angle ọchịchọ ga-abụ 5° ma ọ bụ obere (sin 5°≈0.087), ogologo ga-abụ 15 m ma ọ bụ obere. Ọ bụrụ ogologo bụ L, sin(angle)=1.2÷L.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ogologo ramp na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ?
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s1.r.a: 1.2÷10=0.12 karịrị 0.087, ya mere angle ọchịchọ karịrị 5°.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s1.r.b: 1.2÷12=0.1 karịrị 0.087, ya mere angle ọchịchọ karịrị 5°.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s1.r.d: Slope dị nro, ma ogologo karịrị 15 m.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s1.explain: 1.2÷14≈0.086 bụ 0.087 ma ọ bụ obere, 14 m bụ 15 m ma ọ bụ obere, ya mere ọnọdụ abụọ mezuru.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s2.model.0: Maka 14 m, sin=1.2÷14≈0.086, nke bụ 5° ma ọ bụ obere, ọ bụkwa 15 m ma ọ bụ obere, ya mere ọnọdụ abụọ mezuru.
l-m-m3-b02-39.s.s2.model.1: 10 m na 12 m dị steep ma gafere 5°, 18 m dị ogologo ma gafere 15 m, ya mere 14 m bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b02-40.title: x na-emezu ọnọdụ ogologo na obosara ogige
l-m-m3-b02-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha maka ogige kacha ukwuu na-emezu ogologo na obosara, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b02-40.material: Mpaghara ogige rektangulu bụ x²+7x+10 ㎡, ogologo ya bụ (x+5) m, obosara ya (x+2) m. Ogologo agaghị agafe 20 m, obosara ga-adị opekata mpe 10 m, ịchọrọ ime ya ka o buru ibu dịka o kwere. x bụ integer.
l-m-m3-b02-40.s.s1.prompt: Kedu x maka ogige kacha ukwuu na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ?
l-m-m3-b02-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma mpaghara 130 ㎡ pere mpe karịa mgbe x=15 (340 ㎡).
l-m-m3-b02-40.s.s1.explain: x+5≤20 na x+2≥10, ya mere 8≤x≤15. Mpaghara kasị ukwuu n'ime ndị a bụ x=15, ya bụ 20×17=340 ㎡.
l-m-m3-b02-40.s.s2.model.0: Site na ogologo x+5≤20, x≤15; site na obosara x+2≥10, x≥8, ya mere x kacha ukwuu 15 na-enye mpaghara kasị ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b02-40.s.s2.model.1: Ka x na-abawanye, ogologo na obosara na mpaghara na-abawanye, ya mere x=15, kacha elu na-emezu ọnọdụ ogologo 20 m, ziri ezi.

l-m-m3-b03-36.title: Eriri ụgbọelu kacha mkpụmkpụ nke na-adịghị steepụ oke
l-m-m3-b03-36.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha n’ịchọta eriri ụgbọelu kacha mkpụmkpụ nke mezuru ọnọdụ akụkụ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ya.
l-m-m3-b03-36.material: A na-ewu ụgbọelu eriri n’etiti isi abụọ nwere ọdịiche ịdị elu 300m. Akụkụ eriri na horizontal ga-abụ 40° ma ọ bụ obere (tan 40°≈0.84); ka oghere horizontal na-adị mkpụmkpụ, eriri na-adị mkpụmkpụ. tan(angle)=300÷horizontal distance.
l-m-m3-b03-36.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oghere horizontal kacha nta mezuru ọnọdụ ahụ?
l-m-m3-b03-36.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ akụkụ, mana eriri dị ogologo karịa nke dị na 400m.
l-m-m3-b03-36.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ akụkụ, mana eriri dị ogologo nke ukwuu.

l-m-m3-b03-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha n’ịchọta bọọdụ square kacha ukwuu na-apụghị ịpụ n’efere, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ya.
l-m-m3-b03-40.material: E tinyere bọọdụ square n’elu efere okirikiri dayameta ya bụ 20cm. Bọọdụ agaghị apụ n’efere (diagonal ga-abụ 20cm ma ọ bụ obere); iji tinye kuki, otu akụkụ ga-abụ 12cm ma ọ bụ karịa. Akụkụ bụ integer cm, ịchọrọ bọọdụ kacha ukwuu.

l-m-m3-b03-40.s.s1.r.b: Ọ mezuru ọnọdụ, mana bọọdụ 14cm ka ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b03-40.s.s1.explain: Diagonal square bụ otu akụkụ×√2. 14√2≈19.8cm dị 20cm ma ọ bụ obere; 15√2≈21.2cm karịrị.

l-m-m3-b04-10.goal: Tulee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha mgbe ị na-achọta okwu na-enweghị mgbanwe kacha ukwuu a pụrụ itinye ihe ọnụ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-m3-b04-10.material: Ị chọrọ itinye ihe ọnụ n'ime x²+5x+c ka ọ bụrụ ngwaahịa ngosipụta linear nwere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. c bụ ọnụọgụ eke otu mkpụrụ, c buru ibu karịa ka mma ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ekwe omume.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ c kacha ukwuu nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu abụọ nchikọta ha bụ 5, ngwaahịa ha bụ 9, ya mere a pụghị itinye ihe ọnụ.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s1.r.b: Nchịkọta nke ọnụọgụ zuru ezu abụọ ngwaahịa ha bụ 8 bụ 9 na 6, ya mere ọ gaghị abụ 5.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s1.r.c: Enwere ike itinye ihe ọnụ, ma c ka ukwuu, 6, nwekwara ike.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s1.explain: c=6 na-enye 2+3=5, 2×3=6, ya mere ọ bụ (x+2)(x+3). c=7 ruo 9 anaghị arụ ọrụ, ya mere 6 bụ nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s2.model.0: E nwere 2 na 3 ndị nchikọta ha bụ 5, ngwaahịa ha bụ 6, ya mere c=6 na-aghọ (x+2)(x+3); 7, 8, 9 anaghị arụ ọrụ, ya mere nke a bụ nke kacha ukwuu.
l-m-m3-b04-10.s.s2.model.1: c=9 na 8 anaghị arụ ọrụ n'ihi na nchikọta ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere ngwaahịa kwesịrị ekwesị abụghị 5. Ya mere họrọ 6, c kacha ukwuu na-arụ ọrụ.
